rows.en: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer liveth, And that He will witness at the last upon the dust;

rows.he: וְאַחַר עוֹרִי נִקְּפוּ־זֹאת וּמִבְּשָׂרִי אֶחֱזֶה אֱלוֹהַּ׃
rows.en: And when after my skin this is destroyed, Then without my flesh shall I see God;

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי אֶחֱזֶה־לִּי וְעֵינַי רָאוּ וְלֹא־זָר כָּלוּ כִלְיֹתַי בְּחֵקִי׃
rows.en: Whom I, even I, shall see for myself, And mine eyes shall behold, and not another’s. My reins are consumed within me.

rows.he: כִּי תֹאמְרוּ מַה־נִּרְדָּף־לוֹ וְשֹׁרֶשׁ דָּבָר נִמְצָא־בִי׃
rows.en: If ye say: ‘How we will persecute him! ’ Seeing that the root of the matter is found in me;

rows.he: גּוּרוּ לָכֶם מִפְּנֵי־חֶרֶב כִּי־חֵמָה עֲוֺנוֹת חָרֶב לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּן שדין [שַׁדּוּן׃]
rows.en: Be ye afraid of the sword; For wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, That ye may know there is a judgment.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said:

rows.he: לָכֵן שְׂעִפַּי יְשִׁיבוּנִי וּבַעֲבוּר חוּשִׁי בִי׃
rows.en: Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, Even by reason of mine agitation that is in me.

rows.he: מוּסַר כְּלִמָּתִי אֶשְׁמָע וְרוּחַ מִבִּינָתִי יַעֲנֵנִי׃
rows.en: I have heard the reproof which putteth me to shame, But out of my understanding my spirit answereth me.

rows.he: הֲזֹאת יָדַעְתָּ מִנִּי־עַד מִנִּי שִׂים אָדָם עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ׃
rows.en: Knowest thou not this of old time, Since man was placed upon earth,

rows.he: כִּי רִנְנַת רְשָׁעִים מִקָּרוֹב וְשִׂמְחַת חָנֵף עֲדֵי־רָגַע׃
rows.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the godless but for a moment?

rows.he: אִם־יַעֲלֶה לַשָּׁמַיִם שִׂיאוֹ וְרֹאשׁוֹ לָעָב יַגִּיעַ׃
rows.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, And his head reach unto the clouds;

rows.he: כְּגֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶצַח יֹאבֵד רֹאָיו יֹאמְרוּ אַיּוֹ׃
rows.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung; They that have seen him shall say: ‘Where is he?’

rows.he: כַּחֲלוֹם יָעוּף וְלֹא יִמְצָאוּהוּ וְיֻדַּד כְּחֶזְיוֹן לָיְלָה׃
rows.en: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found; Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

rows.he: עַיִן שְׁזָפַתּוּ וְלֹא תוֹסִיף וְלֹא־עוֹד תְּשׁוּרֶנּוּ מְקוֹמוֹ׃
rows.en: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.

rows.he: בָּנָיו יְרַצּוּ דַלִּים וְיָדָיו תָּשֵׁבְנָה אוֹנוֹ׃
rows.en: His children shall appease the poor, And his hands shall restore his wealth.

rows.he: עַצְמוֹתָיו מָלְאוּ עלומו [עֲלוּמָיו] וְעִמּוֹ עַל־עָפָר תִּשְׁכָּב׃
rows.en: His bones are full of his youth, But it shall lie down with him in the dust.

rows.he: אִם־תַּמְתִּיק בְּפִיו רָעָה יַכְחִידֶנָּה תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ׃
rows.en: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, Though he hide it under his tongue;

rows.he: יַחְמֹל עָלֶיהָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶנָּה וְיִמְנָעֶנָּה בְּתוֹךְ חִכּוֹ׃
rows.en: Though he spare it, and will not let it go, But keep it still within his mouth;

rows.he: לַחְמוֹ בְּמֵעָיו נֶהְפָּךְ מְרוֹרַת פְּתָנִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃
rows.en: Yet his food in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.

rows.he: חַיִל בָּלַע וַיְקִאֶנּוּ מִבִּטְנוֹ יוֹרִשֶׁנּוּ אֵל׃
rows.en: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again; God shall cast them out of his belly.

rows.he: רֹאשׁ־פְּתָנִים יִינָק תַּהַרְגֵהוּ לְשׁוֹן אֶפְעֶה׃
rows.en: He shall suck the poison of asps; The viper’s tongue shall slay him.

rows.he: אַל־יֵרֶא בִפְלַגּוֹת נַהֲרֵי נַחֲלֵי דְּבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָה׃
rows.en: He shall not look upon the rivers, The flowing streams of honey and curd.

rows.he: מֵשִׁיב יָגָע וְלֹא יִבְלָע כְּחֵיל תְּמוּרָתוֹ וְלֹא יַעֲלֹס׃
rows.en: That which he laboured for shall he give back, and shall not swallow it down; According to the substance that he hath gotten, he shall not rejoice.

rows.he: כִּי־רִצַּץ עָזַב דַּלִּים בַּיִת גָּזַל וְלֹא יִבֶנֵהוּ׃
rows.en: For he hath oppressed and forsaken the poor; He hath violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.

rows.he: כִּי לֹא־יָדַע שָׁלֵו בְּבִטְנוֹ בַּחֲמוּדוֹ לֹא יְמַלֵּט׃
rows.en: Because he knew no quietness within him, In his greed he suffered nought to escape,

rows.he: אֵין־שָׂרִיד לְאָכְלוֹ עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יָחִיל טוּבוֹ׃
rows.en: There was nothing left that he devoured not— Therefore his prosperity shall not endure. .

rows.he: בִּמְלֹאות שִׂפְקוֹ יֵצֶר לוֹ כָּל־יַד עָמֵל תְּבוֹאֶנּוּ׃
rows.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits; The hand of every one that is in misery shall come upon him.

rows.he: יְהִי לְמַלֵּא בִטְנוֹ יְשַׁלַּח־בּוֹ חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וְיַמְטֵר עָלֵימוֹ בִּלְחוּמוֹ׃
rows.en: It shall be for the filling of his belly; He shall cast the fierceness of His wrath upon him, And shall cause it to rain upon him into his flesh.

rows.he: יִבְרַח מִנֵּשֶׁק בַּרְזֶל תַּחְלְפֵהוּ קֶשֶׁת נְחוּשָׁה׃
rows.en: If he flee from the iron weapon, The bow of brass shall strike him through.

rows.he: שָׁלַף וַיֵּצֵא מִגֵּוָה וּבָרָק מִמְּרֹרָתוֹ יַהֲלֹךְ עָלָיו אֵמִים׃
rows.en: He draweth it forth, and it cometh out of his body; Yea, the glittering point cometh out of his gall; Terrors are upon him.

rows.he: כָּל־חֹשֶׁךְ טָמוּן לִצְפּוּנָיו תְּאָכְלֵהוּ אֵשׁ לֹא־נֻפָּח יֵרַע שָׂרִיד בְּאָהֳלוֹ׃
rows.en: All darkness is laid up for his treasures; A fire not blown by man shall consume him; It shall go ill with him that is left in his tent.

rows.he: יְגַלּוּ שָׁמַיִם עֲוֺנוֹ וְאֶרֶץ מִתְקוֹמָמָה לוֹ׃
rows.en: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, And the earth shall rise up against him.

rows.he: יִגֶל יְבוּל בֵּיתוֹ נִגָּרוֹת בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ׃
rows.en: The increase of his house shall depart, His goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

rows.he: זֶה חֵלֶק־אָדָם רָשָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִים וְנַחֲלַת אִמְרוֹ מֵאֵל׃
rows.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, And the heritage appointed unto him by God.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then Job answered and said:

rows.he: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ מִלָּתִי וּתְהִי־זֹאת תַּנְחוּמֹתֵיכֶם׃
rows.en: Hear diligently my speech; And let this be your consolations.

rows.he: שָׂאוּנִי וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר וְאַחַר דַּבְּרִי תַלְעִיג׃
rows.en: Suffer me, that I may speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.

rows.he: הֶאָנֹכִי לְאָדָם שִׂיחִי וְאִם־מַדּוּעַ לֹא־תִקְצַר רוּחִי׃
rows.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? Or why should I not be impatient?

rows.he: פְּנוּ־אֵלַי וְהָשַׁמּוּ וְשִׂימוּ יָד עַל־פֶּה׃
rows.en: Turn unto me, and be astonished, And lay your hand upon your mouth.

rows.he: וְאִם־זָכַרְתִּי וְנִבְהָלְתִּי וְאָחַז בְּשָׂרִי פַּלָּצוּת׃
rows.en: Even when I remember I am affrighted, And horror hath taketh hold on my flesh.

rows.he: מַדּוּעַ רְשָׁעִים יִחְיוּ עָתְקוּ גַּם־גָּבְרוּ חָיִל׃
rows.en: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, wax mighty in power?

rows.he: זַרְעָם נָכוֹן לִפְנֵיהֶם עִמָּם וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶם לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃
rows.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, And their offspring before their eyes.

rows.he: בָּתֵּיהֶם שָׁלוֹם מִפָּחַד וְלֹא שֵׁבֶט אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶם׃
rows.en: Their houses are safe, without fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.

rows.he: שׁוֹרוֹ עִבַּר וְלֹא יַגְעִל תְּפַלֵּט פָּרָתוֹ וְלֹא תְשַׁכֵּל׃
rows.en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

rows.he: יְשַׁלְּחוּ כַצֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶם וְיַלְדֵיהֶם יְרַקֵּדוּן׃
rows.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.

rows.he: יִשְׂאוּ כְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר וְיִשְׂמְחוּ לְקוֹל עוּגָב׃
rows.en: They sing to the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

rows.he: יבלו [יְכַלּוּ] בַטּוֹב יְמֵיהֶם וּבְרֶגַע שְׁאוֹל יֵחָתּוּ׃
rows.en: They spend their days in prosperity, And peacefully they go down to the grave.

rows.he: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָאֵל סוּר מִמֶּנּוּ וְדַעַת דְּרָכֶיךָ לֹא חָפָצְנוּ׃
rows.en: Yet they said unto God: ‘Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of Thy ways.

rows.he: מַה־שַׁדַּי כִּי־נַעַבְדֶנּוּ וּמַה־נּוֹעִיל כִּי נִפְגַּע־בּוֹ׃
rows.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve Him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto Him?’—

rows.he: הֵן לֹא בְיָדָם טוּבָם עֲצַת רְשָׁעִים רָחֲקָה מֶנִּי׃
rows.en: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand; The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

rows.he: כַּמָּה נֵר־רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ וְיָבֹא עָלֵימוֹ אֵידָם חֲבָלִים יְחַלֵּק בְּאַפּוֹ׃
rows.en: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity cometh upon them? That He distributeth pains in His anger?

rows.he: יִהְיוּ כְּתֶבֶן לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ וּכְמֹץ גְּנָבַתּוּ סוּפָה׃
rows.en: That they are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm stealeth away?

rows.he: אֱלוֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן־לְבָנָיו אוֹנוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם אֵלָיו וְיֵדָע׃
rows.en: ’God layeth up his iniquity for his children! ’— Let Him recompense it unto himself, that he may know it.

rows.he: יִרְאוּ עינו [עֵינָיו] כִּידוֹ וּמֵחֲמַת שַׁדַּי יִשְׁתֶּה׃
rows.en: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

rows.he: כִּי מַה־חֶפְצוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ אַחֲרָיו וּמִסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁיו חֻצָּצוּ׃
rows.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him? Seeing the number of his months is determined.

rows.he: הַלְאֵל יְלַמֶּד־דָּעַת וְהוּא רָמִים יִשְׁפּוֹט׃
rows.en: Shall any teach God knowledge? Seeing it is He that judgeth those that are high.

rows.he: זֶה יָמוּת בְּעֶצֶם תֻּמּוֹ כֻּלּוֹ שַׁלְאֲנַן וְשָׁלֵיו׃
rows.en: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet;

rows.he: עֲטִינָיו מָלְאוּ חָלָב וּמֹחַ עַצְמוֹתָיו יְשֻׁקֶּה׃
rows.en: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moistened.

rows.he: וְזֶה יָמוּת בְּנֶפֶשׁ מָרָה וְלֹא־אָכַל בַּטּוֹבָה׃
rows.en: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, And hath never tasted of good.

rows.he: יַחַד עַל־עָפָר יִשְׁכָּבוּ וְרִמָּה תְּכַסֶּה עֲלֵיהֶם׃
rows.en: They lie down alike in the dust, And the worm covereth them.

rows.he: הֵן יָדַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם וּמְזִמּוֹת עָלַי תַּחְמֹסוּ׃
rows.en: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

rows.he: כִּי תֹאמְרוּ אַיֵּה בֵית־נָדִיב וְאַיֵּה אֹהֶל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת רְשָׁעִים׃
rows.en: For ye say: ‘Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?’

rows.he: הֲלֹא שְׁאֶלְתֶּם עוֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ וְאֹתֹתָם לֹא תְנַכֵּרוּ׃
rows.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way; And will ye misdeem their tokens,

rows.he: כִּי לְיוֹם אֵיד יֵחָשֶׂךְ רָע לְיוֹם עֲבָרוֹת יוּבָלוּ׃
rows.en: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led forth to the day of wrath?

rows.he: מִי־יַגִּיד עַל־פָּנָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וְהוּא־עָשָׂה מִי יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ׃
rows.en: But who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?

rows.he: וְהוּא לִקְבָרוֹת יוּבָל וְעַל־גָּדִישׁ יִשְׁקוֹד׃
rows.en: For he is borne to the grave, And watch is kept over his tomb.

rows.he: מָתְקוּ־לוֹ רִגְבֵי נָחַל וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל־אָדָם יִמְשׁוֹךְ וּלְפָנָיו אֵין מִסְפָּר׃
rows.en: The clods of the valley are sweet unto him, And all men draw after him, As there were innumerable before him.

rows.he: וְאֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמוּנִי הָבֶל וּתְשׁוּבֹתֵיכֶם נִשְׁאַר־מָעַל׃
rows.en: How then comfort ye me in vain? And as for your answers, there remaineth only faithlessness?

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּמָנִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:

rows.he: הַלְאֵל יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר כִּי־יִסְכֹּן עָלֵימוֹ מַשְׂכִּיל׃
rows.en: Can a man be profitable unto God? Or can he that is wise be profitable unto Him?

rows.he: הַחֵפֶץ לְשַׁדַּי כִּי תִצְדָּק וְאִם־בֶּצַע כִּי־תַתֵּם דְּרָכֶיךָ׃
rows.en: Is it any advantage to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain to Him, that thou makest thy ways blameless?

rows.he: הֲמִיִּרְאָתְךָ יֹכִיחֶךָ יָבוֹא עִמְּךָ בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃
rows.en: Is it for thy fear of Him that He reproveth thee, That He entereth with thee into judgment?

rows.he: הֲלֹא רָעָתְךָ רַבָּה וְאֵין־קֵץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶיךָ׃
rows.en: Is not thy wickedness great? And are not thine iniquities without end?

rows.he: כִּי־תַחְבֹּל אַחֶיךָ חִנָּם וּבִגְדֵי עֲרוּמִּים תַּפְשִׁיט׃
rows.en: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.

rows.he: לֹא־מַיִם עָיֵף תַּשְׁקֶה וּמֵרָעֵב תִּמְנַע־לָחֶם׃
rows.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

rows.he: וְאִישׁ זְרוֹעַ לוֹ הָאָרֶץ וּנְשׂוּא פָנִים יֵשֶׁב בָּהּ׃
rows.en: And as a mighty man, who hath the earth, And as a man of rank, who dwelleth in it,

rows.he: אַלְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּחְתָּ רֵיקָם וּזְרֹעוֹת יְתֹמִים יְדֻכָּא׃
rows.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

rows.he: עַל־כֵּן סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ פַחִים וִיבַהֶלְךָ פַּחַד פִּתְאֹם׃
rows.en: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden dread affrighted thee,

rows.he: אוֹ־חֹשֶׁךְ לֹא־תִרְאֶה וְשִׁפְעַת־מַיִם תְּכַסֶּךָּ׃
rows.en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see, And abundance of waters cover thee.

rows.he: הֲ‍לֹא־אֱלוֹהַּ גֹּבַהּ שָׁמָיִם וּרְאֵה רֹאשׁ כּוֹכָבִים כִּי־רָמּוּ׃
rows.en: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the topmost of the stars, how high they are!

rows.he: וְאָמַרְתָּ מַה־יָּדַע אֵל הַבְעַד עֲרָפֶל יִשְׁפּוֹט׃
rows.en: And thou sayest: ‘What doth God know? Can He judge through the dark cloud?

rows.he: עָבִים סֵתֶר־לוֹ וְלֹא יִרְאֶה וְחוּג שָׁמַיִם יִתְהַלָּךְ׃
rows.en: Thick clouds are a covering to Him, that He seeth not; And He walketh in the circuit of heaven.’

rows.he: הַאֹרַח עוֹלָם תִּשְׁמֹר אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכוּ מְתֵי־אָוֶן׃
rows.en: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר־קֻמְּטוּ וְלֹא־עֵת נָהָר יוּצַק יְסוֹדָם׃
rows.en: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundation was poured out as a stream;

rows.he: הָאֹמְרִים לָאֵל סוּר מִמֶּנּוּ וּמַה־יִּפְעַל שַׁדַּי לָמוֹ׃
rows.en: Who said unto God: ‘Depart from us’; And what could the Almighty do unto them?

rows.he: וְהוּא מִלֵּא בָתֵּיהֶם טוֹב וַעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים רָחֲקָה מֶנִּי׃
rows.en: Yet He filled their houses with good things— But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

rows.he: יִרְאוּ צַדִּיקִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְנָקִי יִלְעַג־לָמוֹ׃
rows.en: The righteous saw it, and were glad, And the innocent laugh them to scorn:

rows.he: אִם־לֹא נִכְחַד קִימָנוּ וְיִתְרָם אָכְלָה אֵשׁ׃
rows.en: ’Surely their substance is cut off, And their abundance the fire hath consumed.’

rows.he: הַסְכֶּן־נָא עִמּוֹ וּשְׁלם בָּהֶם תְּבוֹאַתְךָ טוֹבָה׃
rows.en: Acquaint now thyself with Him, and be at peace; Thereby shall thine increase be good.

rows.he: קַח־נָא מִפִּיו תּוֹרָה וְשִׂים אֲמָרָיו בִּלְבָבֶךָ׃
rows.en: Receive, I pray thee, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in thy heart.

rows.he: אִם־תָּשׁוּב עַד־שַׁדַּי תִּבָּנֶה תַּרְחִיק עַוְלָה מֵאָהֳלֶךָ׃
rows.en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up— If thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents,

rows.he: וְשִׁית־עַל־עָפָר בָּצֶר וּבְצוּר נְחָלִים אוֹפִיר׃
rows.en: And lay thy treasure in the dust, And the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks;

rows.he: וְהָיָה שַׁדַּי בְּצָרֶיךָ וְכֶסֶף תּוֹעָפוֹת לָךְ׃
rows.en: And the Almighty be thy treasure, And precious silver unto thee;

rows.he: כִּי־אָז עַל־שַׁדַּי תִּתְעַנָּג וְתִשָּׂא אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ פָּנֶיךָ׃
rows.en: Then surely shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.

rows.he: תַּעְתִּיר אֵלָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶךָּ וּנְדָרֶיךָ תְשַׁלֵּם׃
rows.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto Him, and He will hear thee, And thou shalt pay thy vows;

rows.he: וְתִגְזַר־אוֹמֶר וְיָקָם לָךְ וְעַל־דְּרָכֶיךָ נָגַהּ אוֹר׃
rows.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, And light shall shine upon thy ways.

rows.he: כִּי־הִשְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּאמֶר גֵּוָה וְשַׁח עֵינַיִם יוֹשִׁעַ׃
rows.en: When they cast thee down, thou shalt say: ‘There is lifting up’; For the humble person He saveth.

rows.he: יְמַלֵּט אִי־נָקִי וְנִמְלַט בְּבֹר כַּפֶּיךָ׃
rows.en: He delivereth him that is innocent, Yea, thou shalt be delivered through the cleanness of thy hands.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then Job answered and said:

rows.he: גַּם־הַיּוֹם מְרִי שִׂחִי יָדִי כָּבְדָה עַל־אַנְחָתִי׃
rows.en: Even to-day is my complaint bitter; My hand is become heavy because of my groaning.

rows.he: מִי־יִתֵּן יָדַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵהוּ אָבוֹא עַד־תְּכוּנָתוֹ׃
rows.en: Oh that I knew where I might find Him, That I might come even to His seat!

rows.he: אֶעֶרְכָה לְפָנָיו מִשְׁפָּט וּפִי אֲמַלֵּא תוֹכָחוֹת׃
rows.en: I would order my cause before Him, And fill my mouth with arguments.

rows.he: אֵדְעָה מִלִּים יַעֲנֵנִי וְאָבִינָה מַה־יֹּאמַר לִי׃
rows.en: I would know the words which He would answer me, And understand what He would say unto me.

rows.he: הַבְּרָב־כֹּחַ יָרִיב עִמָּדִי לֹא אַךְ־הוּא יָשִׂם בִּי׃
rows.en: Would He contend with me in His great power? Nay; but He would give heed unto me.

rows.he: שָׁם יָשָׁר נוֹכָח עִמּוֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָה לָנֶצַח מִשֹּׁפְטִי׃
rows.en: There the upright might reason with Him; So should I be delivered for ever from my Judge.

rows.he: הֵן קֶדֶם אֶהֱלֹךְ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְאָחוֹר וְלֹא־אָבִין לוֹ׃
rows.en: Behold, I go forward, but He is not there, And backward, but I cannot perceive Him;

rows.he: שְׂמֹאול בַּעֲשֹׂתוֹ וְלֹא־אָחַז יַעְטֹף יָמִין וְלֹא אֶרְאֶה׃
rows.en: On the left hand, when He doth work, but I cannot behold Him, He turneth Himself to the right hand, but I cannot see Him.

rows.he: כִּי־יָדַע דֶּרֶךְ עִמָּדִי בְּחָנַנִי כַּזָּהָב אֵצֵא׃
rows.en: For He knoweth the way that I take; When He hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

rows.he: בַּאֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָה רַגְלִי דַּרְכּוֹ שָׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא־אָט׃
rows.en: My foot hath held fast to His steps, His way have I kept, and turned not aside.

rows.he: מִצְוַת שְׂפָתָיו וְלֹא אָמִישׁ מֵחֻקִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרֵי־פִיו׃
rows.en: I have not gone back from the commandment of His lips; I have treasured up the words of His mouth more than my necessary food.

rows.he: וְהוּא בְאֶחָד וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ אִוְּתָה וַיָּעַשׂ׃
rows.en: But He is at one with Himself, and who can turn Him? And what His soul desireth, even that He doeth. .

rows.he: כִּי יַשְׁלִים חֻקִּי וְכָהֵנָּה רַבּוֹת עִמּוֹ׃
rows.en: For He will perform that which is appointed for me; And many such things are with Him.

rows.he: עַל־כֵּן מִפָּנָיו אֶבָּהֵל אֶתְבּוֹנֵן וְאֶפְחַד מִמֶּנּוּ׃
rows.en: Therefore am I affrighted at His presence; When I consider, I am afraid of Him.

rows.he: וְאֵל הֵרַךְ לִבִּי וְשַׁדַּי הִבְהִילָנִי׃
rows.en: Yea, God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath affrighted me;

rows.he: כִּי־לֹא נִצְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ וּמִפָּנַי כִּסָּה־אֹפֶל׃
rows.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did He cover the thick darkness from my face.

rows.he: מַדּוּעַ מִשַּׁדַּי לֹא־נִצְפְּנוּ עִתִּים וידעו [וְיֹדְעָיו] לֹא־חָזוּ יָמָיו׃
rows.en: Why are times not laid up by the Almighty? And why do not they that know Him see His days?

rows.he: גְּבֻלוֹת יַשִּׂיגוּ עֵדֶר גָּזְלוּ וַיִּרְעוּ׃
rows.en: There are that remove the landmarks; They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

rows.he: חֲמוֹר יְתוֹמִים יִנְהָגוּ יַחְבְּלוּ שׁוֹר אַלְמָנָה׃
rows.en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, They take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

rows.he: יַטּוּ אֶבְיוֹנִים מִדָּרֶךְ יַחַד חֻבְּאוּ עֲנִיֵּי־אָרֶץ׃
rows.en: They turn the needy out of the way; The poor of the earth hide themselves together.

rows.he: הֵן פְּרָאִים בַּמִּדְבָּר יָצְאוּ בְּפָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵי לַטָּרֶף עֲרָבָה לוֹ לֶחֶם לַנְּעָרִים׃
rows.en: Behold, as wild asses in the wilderness They go forth to their work, seeking diligently for food; The desert yieldeth them bread for their children.

rows.he: בַּשָּׂדֶה בְּלִילוֹ יקצירו [יִקְצוֹרוּ] וְכֶרֶם רָשָׁע יְלַקֵּשׁוּ׃
rows.en: They cut his provender in the field; And they despoil the vineyard of the wicked.

rows.he: עָרוֹם יָלִינוּ מִבְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וְאֵין כְּסוּת בַּקָּרָה׃
rows.en: They lie all night naked without clothing, And have no covering in the cold.

rows.he: מִזֶּרֶם הָרִים יִרְטָבוּ וּמִבְּלִי מַחְסֶה חִבְּקוּ־צוּר׃
rows.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

rows.he: יִגְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁד יָתוֹם וְעַל־עָנִי יַחְבֹּלוּ׃
rows.en: There are that pluck the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge of the poor;

rows.he: עָרוֹם הִלְּכוּ בְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וּרְעֵבִים נָשְׂאוּ עֹמֶר׃
rows.en: So that they go about naked without clothing, And being hungry they carry the sheaves;

rows.he: בֵּין־שׁוּרֹתָם יַצְהִירוּ יְקָבִים דָּרְכוּ וַיִּצְמָאוּ׃
rows.en: They make oil within the rows of these men; They tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

rows.he: מֵעִיר מְתִים יִנְאָקוּ וְנֶפֶשׁ־חֲלָלִים תְּשַׁוֵּעַ וֶאֱלוֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׂים תִּפְלָה׃
rows.en: From out of the populous city men groan, And the soul of the wounded crieth out; Yet God imputeth it not for unseemliness.

rows.he: הֵמָּה הָיוּ בְּמֹרְדֵי־אוֹר לֹא־הִכִּירוּ דְרָכָיו וְלֹא יָשְׁבוּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָיו׃
rows.en: These are of them that rebel against the light; They know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

rows.he: לָאוֹר יָקוּם רוֹצֵחַ יִקְטָל־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וּבַלַּיְלָה יְהִי כַגַּנָּב׃
rows.en: The murderer riseth with the light, to kill the poor and needy; And in the night he is as a thief.

rows.he: וְעֵין נֹאֵף שָׁמְרָה נֶשֶׁף לֵאמֹר לֹא־תְשׁוּרֵנִי עָיִן וְסֵתֶר פָּנִים יָשִׂים׃
rows.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, Saying: ‘No eye shall see me’; And he putteth a covering on his face. .

rows.he: חָתַר בַּחֹשֶׁךְ בָּתִּים יוֹמָם חִתְּמוּ־לָמוֹ לֹא־יָדְעוּ אוֹר׃
rows.en: In the dark they dig through houses; They shut themselves up in the day-time; They know not the light.

rows.he: כִּי יַחְדָּו בֹּקֶר לָמוֹ צַלְמָוֶת כִּי־יַכִּיר בַּלְהוֹת צַלְמָוֶת׃
rows.en: For the shadow of death is to all of them as the morning; For they know the terrors of the shadow of death.

rows.he: קַל־הוּא עַל־פְּנֵי־מַיִם תְּקֻלַּל חֶלְקָתָם בָּאָרֶץ לֹא־יִפְנֶה דֶּרֶךְ כְּרָמִים׃
rows.en: He is swift upon the face of the waters; Their portion is cursed in the earth; He turneth not by the way of the vineyards.

rows.he: צִיָּה גַם־חֹם יִגְזְלוּ מֵימֵי־שֶׁלֶג שְׁאוֹל חָטָאוּ׃
rows.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters; So doth the nether-world those that have sinned.

rows.he: יִשְׁכָּחֵהוּ רֶחֶם מְתָקוֹ רִמָּה עוֹד לֹא־יִזָּכֵר וַתִּשָּׁבֵר כָּעֵץ עַוְלָה׃
rows.en: The womb forgetteth him; the worm feedeth sweetly on him; He shall be no more remembered; And unrighteousness is broken as a tree.

rows.he: רֹעֶה עֲקָרָה לֹא תֵלֵד וְאַלְמָנָה לֹא יְיֵטִיב׃
rows.en: He devoureth the barren that beareth not; And doeth not good to the widow.

rows.he: וּמָשַׁךְ אַבִּירִים בְּכֹחוֹ יָקוּם וְלֹא־יַאֲמִין בַּחַיִּין׃
rows.en: He draweth away the mighty also by his power; He riseth up, and he trusteth not his own life.

rows.he: יִתֶּן־לוֹ לָבֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵן וְעֵינֵיהוּ עַל־דַּרְכֵיהֶם׃
rows.en: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth, Yet His eyes are upon their ways.

rows.he: רוֹמּוּ מְּעַט וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְהֻמְּכוּ כַּכֹּל יִקָּפְצוּן וּכְרֹאשׁ שִׁבֹּלֶת יִמָּלוּ׃
rows.en: They are exalted for a little while, and they are gone; Yea, they are brought low, they are gathered in as all others, And wither as the tops of the ears of corn.

rows.he: וְאִם־לֹא אֵפוֹ מִי יַכְזִיבֵנִי וְיָשֵׂם לְאַל מִלָּתִי׃
rows.en: And if it be not so now, who will prove me a liar, And make my speech nothing worth?

rows.he: וַיַּעַן בִּלְדַּד הַשֻּׁחִי וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:

rows.he: הַמְשֵׁל וָפַחַד עִמּוֹ עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו׃
rows.en: Dominion and fear are with Him; He maketh peace in His high places.

rows.he: הֲיֵשׁ מִסְפָּר לִגְדוּדָיו וְעַל־מִי לֹא־יָקוּם אוֹרֵהוּ׃
rows.en: Is there any number of His armies? And upon whom doth not His light arise?

rows.he: וּמַה־יִּצְדַּק אֱנוֹשׁ עִם־אֵל וּמַה־יִּזְכֶּה יְלוּד אִשָּׁה׃
rows.en: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

rows.he: הֵן עַד־יָרֵחַ וְלֹא יַאֲהִיל וְכוֹכָבִים לֹא־זַכּוּ בְעֵינָיו׃
rows.en: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, And the stars are not pure in His sight;

rows.he: אַף כִּי־אֱנוֹשׁ רִמָּה וּבֶן־אָדָם תּוֹלֵעָה׃
rows.en: How much less man, that is a worm! And the son of man, that is a maggot!

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then Job answered and said:

rows.he: מֶה־עָזַרְתָּ לְלֹא־כֹחַ הוֹשַׁעְתָּ זְרוֹעַ לֹא־עֹז׃
rows.en: How hast thou helped him that is without power! How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!

rows.he: מַה־יָּעַצְתָּ לְלֹא חָכְמָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה לָרֹב הוֹדָעְתָּ׃
rows.en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, And plentifully declared sound knowledge!

rows.he: אֶת־מִי הִגַּדְתָּ מִלִּין וְנִשְׁמַת־מִי יָצְאָה מִמֶּךָּ׃
rows.en: With whose help hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came forth from thee?

rows.he: הָרְפָאִים יְחוֹלָלוּ מִתַּחַת מַיִם וְשֹׁכְנֵיהֶם׃
rows.en: The shades tremble Beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.

rows.he: עָרוֹם שְׁאוֹל נֶגְדּוֹ וְאֵין כְּסוּת לָאֲבַדּוֹן׃
rows.en: The nether-world is naked before Him, And Destruction hath no covering.

rows.he: נֹטֶה צָפוֹן עַל־תֹּהוּ תֹּלֶה אֶרֶץ עַל־בְּלִי־מָה׃
rows.en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty space, And hangeth the earth over nothing.

rows.he: צֹרֵר־מַיִם בְּעָבָיו וְלֹא־נִבְקַע עָנָן תַּחְתָּם׃
rows.en: He bindeth up the waters in His thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.

rows.he: מְאַחֵז פְּנֵי־כִסֵּה פַּרְשֵׁז עָלָיו עֲנָנוֹ׃
rows.en: He closeth in the face of His throne, And spreadeth His cloud upon it.

rows.he: חֹק־חָג עַל־פְּנֵי־מָיִם עַד־תַּכְלִית אוֹר עִם־חֹשֶׁךְ׃
rows.en: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters, Unto the confines of light and darkness.

rows.he: עַמּוּדֵי שָׁמַיִם יְרוֹפָפוּ וְיִתְמְהוּ מִגַּעֲרָתוֹ׃
rows.en: The pillars of heaven tremble And are astonished at His rebuke.

rows.he: בְּכֹחוֹ רָגַע הַיָּם ובתובנתו [וּבִתְבוּנָתוֹ] מָחַץ רָהַב׃
rows.en: He stirreth up the sea with His power, And by His understanding He smiteth through Rahab.

rows.he: בְּרוּחוֹ שָׁמַיִם שִׁפְרָה חֹלֲלָה יָדוֹ נָחָשׁ בָּרִיחַ׃
rows.en: By His breath the heavens are serene; His hand hath pierced the slant serpent.

rows.he: הֶן־אֵלֶּה קְצוֹת דרכו [דְּרָכָיו] וּמַה־שֵּׁמֶץ דָּבָר נִשְׁמַע־בּוֹ וְרַעַם גבורתו [גְּבוּרוֹתָיו] מִי יִתְבּוֹנָן׃
rows.en: Lo, these are but the outskirts of His ways; And how small a whisper is heard of Him! But the thunder of His mighty deeds who can understand?

rows.he: וַיֹּסֶף אִיּוֹב שְׂאֵת מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: And Job again took up his parable, and said:

rows.he: חַי־אֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִי וְשַׁדַּי הֵמַר נַפְשִׁי׃
rows.en: As God liveth, who hath taken away my right; And the Almighty, who hath dealt bitterly with me;

rows.he: כִּי־כָל־עוֹד נִשְׁמָתִי בִי וְרוּחַ אֱלוֹהַּ בְּאַפִּי׃
rows.en: All the while my breath is in me And the spirit of God is in my nostrils,

rows.he: אִם־תְּדַבֵּרְנָה שְׂפָתַי עַוְלָה וּלְשׁוֹנִי אִם־יֶהְגֶּה רְמִיָּה׃
rows.en: Surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, Neither shall my tongue utter deceit;

rows.he: חָלִילָה לִּי אִם־אַצְדִּיק אֶתְכֶם עַד־אֶגְוָע לֹא־אָסִיר תֻּמָּתִי מִמֶּנִּי׃
rows.en: Far be it from me that I should justify you; Till I die I will not put away mine integrity from me.

rows.he: בְּצִדְקָתִי הֶחֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹא אַרְפֶּהָ לֹא־יֶחֱרַף לְבָבִי מִיָּמָי׃
rows.en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go; My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

rows.he: יְהִי כְרָשָׁע אֹיְבִי וּמִתְקוֹמְמִי כְעַוָּל׃
rows.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And let him that riseth up against me be as the unrighteous.

rows.he: כִּי מַה־תִּקְוַת חָנֵף כִּי יִבְצָע כִּי יֵשֶׁל אֱלוֹהַּ נַפְשׁוֹ׃
rows.en: For what is the hope of the godless, though he get him gain, When God taketh away his soul?

rows.he: הַצַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַע אֵל כִּי־תָבוֹא עָלָיו צָרָה׃
rows.en: Will God hear his cry, When trouble cometh upon him?

rows.he: אִם־עַל־שַׁדַּי יִתְעַנָּג יִקְרָא אֱלוֹהַּ בְּכָל־עֵת׃
rows.en: Will he have his delight in the Almighty, And call upon God at all times?

rows.he: אוֹרֶה אֶתְכֶם בְּיַד־אֵל אֲשֶׁר עִם־שַׁדַּי לֹא אֲכַחֵד׃
rows.en: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

rows.he: הֵן־אַתֶּם כֻּלְּכֶם חֲזִיתֶם וְלָמָּה־זֶּה הֶבֶל תֶּהְבָּלוּ׃
rows.en: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye become altogether vain?

rows.he: זֶה חֵלֶק־אָדָם רָשָׁע עִם־אֵל וְנַחֲלַת עָרִיצִים מִשַּׁדַּי יִקָּחוּ׃
rows.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

rows.he: אִם־יִרְבּוּ בָנָיו לְמוֹ־חָרֶב וְצֶאֱצָאָיו לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ־לָחֶם׃
rows.en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; And his offspring shall not have bread enough.

rows.he: שרידו [שְׂרִידָיו] בַּמָּוֶת יִקָּבֵרוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה׃
rows.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried by pestilence, And his widows shall make no lamentation.

rows.he: אִם־יִצְבֹּר כֶּעָפָר כָּסֶף וְכַחֹמֶר יָכִין מַלְבּוּשׁ׃
rows.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;

rows.he: יָכִין וְצַדִּיק יִלְבָּשׁ וְכֶסֶף נָקִי יַחֲלֹק׃
rows.en: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.

rows.he: בָּנָה כָעָשׁ בֵּיתוֹ וּכְסֻכָּה עָשָׂה נֹצֵר׃
rows.en: He buildeth his house as a moth, And as a booth which the keeper maketh.

rows.he: עָשִׁיר יִשְׁכַּב וְלֹא יֵאָסֵף עֵינָיו פָּקַח וְאֵינֶנּוּ׃
rows.en: He lieth down rich, but there shall be nought to gather; He openeth his eyes, and his wealth is not.

rows.he: תַּשִּׂיגֵהוּ כַמַּיִם בַּלָּהוֹת לַיְלָה גְּנָבַתּוּ סוּפָה׃
rows.en: Terrors overtake him like waters; A tempest stealeth him away in the night.

rows.he: יִשָּׂאֵהוּ קָדִים וְיֵלַךְ וִישָׂעֲרֵהוּ מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃
rows.en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth; And it sweepeth him out of his place.

rows.he: וְיַשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו וְלֹא יַחְמֹל מִיָּדוֹ בָּרוֹחַ יִבְרָח׃
rows.en: Yea, it hurleth at him, and spareth not; He would fain flee from its power.

rows.he: יִשְׂפֹּק עָלֵימוֹ כַפֵּימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹק עָלָיו מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃
rows.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.

rows.he: כִּי יֵשׁ לַכֶּסֶף מוֹצָא וּמָקוֹם לַזָּהָב יָזֹקּוּ׃
rows.en: For there is a mine for silver, And a place for gold which they refine.

rows.he: בַּרְזֶל מֵעָפָר יֻקָּח וְאֶבֶן יָצוּק נְחוּשָׁה׃
rows.en: Iron is taken out of the dust, And brass is molten out of the stone.

rows.he: קֵץ שָׂם לַחֹשֶׁךְ וּלְכָל־תַּכְלִית הוּא חוֹקֵר אֶבֶן אֹפֶל וְצַלְמָוֶת׃
rows.en: Man setteth an end to darkness, And searcheth out to the furthest bound The stones of thick darkness and of the shadow of death.

rows.he: פָּרַץ נַחַל מֵעִם־גָּר הַנִּשְׁכָּחִים מִנִּי־רָגֶל דַּלּוּ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ נָעוּ׃
rows.en: He breaketh open a shaft away from where men sojourn; They are forgotten of the foot that passeth by; They hang afar from men, they swing to and fro.

rows.he: אֶרֶץ מִמֶּנָּה יֵצֵא־לָחֶם וְתַחְתֶּיהָ נֶהְפַּךְ כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ׃
rows.en: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread, And underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

rows.he: מְקוֹם־סַפִּיר אֲבָנֶיהָ וְעַפְרֹת זָהָב לוֹ׃
rows.en: The stones thereof are the place of sapphires, And it hath dust of gold.

rows.he: נָתִיב לֹא־יְדָעוֹ עָיִט וְלֹא שְׁזָפַתּוּ עֵין אַיָּה׃
rows.en: That path no bird of prey knoweth, Neither hath the falcon’s eye seen it;

rows.he: לֹא־הִדְרִיכֻהוּ בְנֵי־שָׁחַץ לֹא־עָדָה עָלָיו שָׁחַל׃
rows.en: The proud beasts have not trodden it, Nor hath the lion passed thereby.

rows.he: בַּחַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַח יָדוֹ הָפַךְ מִשֹּׁרֶשׁ הָרִים׃
rows.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.

rows.he: בַּצּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִים בִּקֵּעַ וְכָל־יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ׃
rows.en: He cutteth out channels among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing. .

rows.he: מִבְּכִי נְהָרוֹת חִבֵּשׁ וְתַעֲלֻמָהּ יֹצִא אוֹר׃
rows.en: He bindeth the streams that they trickle not; And the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

rows.he: וְהַחָכְמָה מֵאַיִן תִּמָּצֵא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָה׃
rows.en: But wisdom, where shall it be found? And where is the place of understanding?

rows.he: לֹא־יָדַע אֱנוֹשׁ עֶרְכָּהּ וְלֹא תִמָּצֵא בְּאֶרֶץ הַחַיִּים׃
rows.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

rows.he: תְּהוֹם אָמַר לֹא בִי־הִיא וְיָם אָמַר אֵין עִמָּדִי׃
rows.en: The deep saith: ‘It is not in me’; And the sea saith: ‘It is not with me.’

rows.he: לֹא־יֻתַּן סְגוֹר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְלֹא יִשָּׁקֵל כֶּסֶף מְחִירָהּ׃
rows.en: It cannot be gotten for gold, Neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

rows.he: לֹא־תְסֻלֶּה בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר בְּשֹׁהַם יָקָר וְסַפִּיר׃
rows.en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, With the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

rows.he: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶנָּה זָהָב וּזְכוֹכִית וּתְמוּרָתָהּ כְּלִי־פָז׃
rows.en: Gold and glass cannot equal it; Neither shall the exchange thereof be vessels of fine gold.

rows.he: רָאמוֹת וְגָבִישׁ לֹא יִזָּכֵר וּמֶשֶׁךְ חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִים׃
rows.en: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal; Yea, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

rows.he: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־כּוּשׁ בְּכֶתֶם טָהוֹר לֹא תְסֻלֶּה׃
rows.en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

rows.he: וְהַחָכְמָה מֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָה׃
rows.en: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?

rows.he: וְנֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵי כָל־חָי וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם נִסְתָּרָה׃
rows.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, And kept close from the fowls of the air.

rows.he: אֲבַדּוֹן וָמָוֶת אָמְרוּ בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ שִׁמְעָהּ׃
rows.en: Destruction and Death say: ‘We have heard a rumor thereof with our ears.’

rows.he: אֱלֹהִים הֵבִין דַּרְכָּהּ וְהוּא יָדַע אֶת־מְקוֹמָהּ׃
rows.en: God understandeth the way thereof, And He knoweth the place thereof.

rows.he: כִּי־הוּא לִקְצוֹת־הָאָרֶץ יַבִּיט תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְאֶה׃
rows.en: For He looketh to the ends of the earth, And seeth under the whole heaven;

rows.he: לַעֲשׂוֹת לָרוּחַ מִשְׁקָל וּמַיִם תִּכֵּן בְּמִדָּה׃
rows.en: When He maketh a weight for the wind, And meteth out the waters by measure.

rows.he: בַּעֲשֹׂתוֹ לַמָּטָר חֹק וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלוֹת׃
rows.en: When He made a decree for the rain, And a way for the storm of thunders;

rows.he: אָז רָאָהּ וַיְסַפְּרָהּ הֱכִינָהּ וְגַם־חֲקָרָהּ׃
rows.en: Then did He see it, and declare it; He established it, yea, and searched it out.

rows.he: וַיֹּאמֶר לָאָדָם הֵן יִרְאַת אֲדֹנָי הִיא חָכְמָה וְסוּר מֵרָע בִּינָה׃
rows.en: And unto man He said: ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to depart from evil is understanding.’

rows.he: וַיֹּסֶף אִיּוֹב שְׂאֵת מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: And Job again took up his parable, and said:

rows.he: מִי־יִתְּנֵנִי כְיַרְחֵי־קֶדֶם כִּימֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵנִי׃
rows.en: Oh that I were as in the months of old, As in the days when God watched over me;

rows.he: בְּהִלּוֹ נֵרוֹ עֲלֵי רֹאשִׁי לְאוֹרוֹ אֵלֶךְ חֹשֶׁךְ׃
rows.en: When His lamp shined above my head, And by His light I walked through darkness;

rows.he: כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי בִּימֵי חָרְפִּי בְּסוֹד אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵי אָהֳלִי׃
rows.en: As I was in the days of my youth, When the converse of God was upon my tent;

rows.he: בְּעוֹד שַׁדַּי עִמָּדִי סְבִיבוֹתַי נְעָרָי׃
rows.en: When the Almighty was yet with me, And my children were about me;

rows.he: בִּרְחֹץ הֲלִיכַי בְּחֵמָה וְצוּר יָצוּק עִמָּדִי פַּלְגֵי־שָׁמֶן׃
rows.en: When my steps were washed with butter, And the rock poured me out rivers of oil!

rows.he: בְּצֵאתִי שַׁעַר עֲלֵי־קָרֶת בָּרְחוֹב אָכִין מוֹשָׁבִי׃
rows.en: When I went forth to the gate unto the city, When I prepared my seat in the broad place,

rows.he: רָאוּנִי נְעָרִים וְנֶחְבָּאוּ וִישִׁישִׁים קָמוּ עָמָדוּ׃
rows.en: The young men saw me and hid themselves, And the aged rose up and stood;

rows.he: שָׂרִים עָצְרוּ בְמִלִּים וְכַף יָשִׂימוּ לְפִיהֶם׃
rows.en: The princes refrained talking, And laid their hand on their mouth;

rows.he: קוֹל־נְגִידִים נֶחְבָּאוּ וּלְשׁוֹנָם לְחִכָּם דָּבֵקָה׃
rows.en: The voice of the nobles was hushed, And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

rows.he: כִּי אֹזֶן שָׁמְעָה וַתְּאַשְּׁרֵנִי וְעַיִן רָאֲתָה וַתְּעִידֵנִי׃
rows.en: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, And when the eye saw me, it gave witness unto me;

rows.he: כִּי־אֲמַלֵּט עָנִי מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְיָתוֹם וְלֹא־עֹזֵר לוֹ׃
rows.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried, The fatherless also, that had none to help him.

rows.he: בִּרְכַּת אֹבֵד עָלַי תָּבֹא וְלֵב אַלְמָנָה אַרְנִן׃
rows.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me; and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

rows.he: צֶדֶק לָבַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁנִי כִּמְעִיל וְצָנִיף מִשְׁפָּטִי׃
rows.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed itself with me; My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

rows.he: עֵינַיִם הָיִיתִי לַעִוֵּר וְרַגְלַיִם לַפִּסֵּחַ אָנִי׃
rows.en: I was eyes to the blind, And feet was I to the lame.

rows.he: אָב אָנֹכִי לָאֶבְיוֹנִים וְרִב לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵהוּ׃
rows.en: I was a father to the needy; And the cause of him that I knew not I searched out.

rows.he: וָאֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּעוֹת עַוָּל וּמִשִּׁנָּיו אַשְׁלִיךְ טָרֶף׃
rows.en: And I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, And plucked the prey out of his teeth.

rows.he: וָאֹמַר עִם־קִנִּי אֶגְוָע וְכַחוֹל אַרְבֶּה יָמִים׃
rows.en: Then I said: ‘I shall die with my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the phoenix;

rows.he: שָׁרְשִׁי פָתוּחַ אֱלֵי־מָיִם וְטַל יָלִין בִּקְצִירִי׃
rows.en: My root shall be spread out to the waters, And the dew shall lie all night upon my branch;

rows.he: כְּבוֹדִי חָדָשׁ עִמָּדִי וְקַשְׁתִּי בְּיָדִי תַחֲלִיף׃
rows.en: My glory shall be fresh in me, And my bow shall be renewed in my hand.’

rows.he: לִי־שָׁמְעוּ וְיִחֵלּוּ וְיִדְּמוּ לְמוֹ עֲצָתִי׃
rows.en: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.

rows.he: אַחֲרֵי דְבָרִי לֹא יִשְׁנוּ וְעָלֵימוֹ תִּטֹּף מִלָּתִי׃
rows.en: After my words they spoke not again; And my speech dropped upon them.

rows.he: וְיִחֲלוּ כַמָּטָר לִי וּפִיהֶם פָּעֲרוּ לְמַלְקוֹשׁ׃
rows.en: And they waited for me as for the rain; And they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

rows.he: אֶשְׂחַק אֲלֵהֶם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ וְאוֹר פָּנַי לֹא יַפִּילוּן׃
rows.en: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; And the light of my countenance they cast not down.

rows.he: אֶבֲחַר דַּרְכָּם וְאֵשֵׁב רֹאשׁ וְאֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶלֶךְ בַּגְּדוּד כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲבֵלִים יְנַחֵם׃
rows.en: I chose out their way, and sat as chief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.

rows.he: וְעַתָּה שָׂחֲקוּ עָלַי צְעִירִים מִמֶּנִּי לְיָמִים אֲשֶׁר־מָאַסְתִּי אֲבוֹתָם לָשִׁית עִם־כַּלְבֵי צֹאנִי׃
rows.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.

rows.he: גַּם־כֹּחַ יְדֵיהֶם לָמָּה לִּי עָלֵימוֹ אָבַד כָּלַח׃
rows.en: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? Men in whom ripe age is perished.

rows.he: בְּחֶסֶר וּבְכָפָן גַּלְמוּד הַעֹרְקִים צִיָּה אֶמֶשׁ שׁוֹאָה וּמְשֹׁאָה׃
rows.en: They are gaunt with want and famine; They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.

rows.he: הַקֹּטְפִים מַלּוּחַ עֲלֵי־שִׂיחַ וְשֹׁרֶשׁ רְתָמִים לַחְמָם׃
rows.en: They pluck salt-wort with wormwood; And the roots of the broom are their food.

rows.he: מִן־גֵּו יְגֹרָשׁוּ יָרִיעוּ עָלֵימוֹ כַּגַּנָּב׃
rows.en: They are driven forth from the midst of men; They cry after them as after a thief.

rows.he: בַּעֲרוּץ נְחָלִים לִשְׁכֹּן חֹרֵי עָפָר וְכֵפִים׃
rows.en: In the clefts of the valleys must they dwell, In holes of the earth and of the rocks.

rows.he: בֵּין־שִׂיחִים יִנְהָקוּ תַּחַת חָרוּל יְסֻפָּחוּ׃
rows.en: Among the bushes they bray; Under the nettles they are gathered together.

rows.he: בְּנֵי־נָבָל גַּם־בְּנֵי בְלִי־שֵׁם נִכְּאוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
rows.en: They are children of churls, yea, children of ignoble men; They were scourged out of the land.

rows.he: וְעַתָּה נְגִינָתָם הָיִיתִי וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמִלָּה׃
rows.en: And now I am become their song, Yea, I am a byword unto them.

rows.he: תִּעֲבוּנִי רָחֲקוּ מֶנִּי וּמִפָּנַי לֹא־חָשְׂכוּ רֹק׃
rows.en: They abhor me, they flee far from me, And spare not to spit in my face.

rows.he: כִּי־יתרו [יִתְרִי] פִתַּח וַיְעַנֵּנִי וְרֶסֶן מִפָּנַי שִׁלֵּחוּ׃
rows.en: For He hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, And they have cast off the bridle before me.

rows.he: עַל־יָמִין פִּרְחַח יָקוּמוּ רַגְלַי שִׁלֵּחוּ וַיָּסֹלּוּ עָלַי אָרְחוֹת אֵידָם׃
rows.en: Upon my right hand rise the brood; They entangle my feet, And they cast up against me their ways of destruction.

rows.he: נָתְסוּ נְתִיבָתִי לְהַוָּתִי יֹעִילוּ לֹא עֹזֵר לָמוֹ׃
rows.en: They break up my path, They further my calamity, Even men that have no helper.

rows.he: כְּפֶרֶץ רָחָב יֶאֱתָיוּ תַּחַת שֹׁאָה הִתְגַּלְגָּלוּ׃
rows.en: As through a wide breach they come; In the midst of the ruin they roll themselves upon me.

rows.he: הָהְפַּךְ עָלַי בַּלָּהוֹת תִּרְדֹּף כָּרוּחַ נְדִבָתִי וּכְעָב עָבְרָה יְשֻׁעָתִי׃
rows.en: Terrors are turned upon me, They chase mine honour as the wind; And my welfare is passed away as a cloud.

rows.he: וְעַתָּה עָלַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּךְ נַפְשִׁי יֹאחֲזוּנִי יְמֵי־עֹנִי׃
rows.en: And now my soul is poured out within me; Days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

rows.he: לַיְלָה עֲצָמַי נִקַּר מֵעָלָי וְעֹרְקַי לֹא יִשְׁכָּבוּן׃
rows.en: In the night my bones are pierced, and fall from me, And my sinews take no rest.

rows.he: בְּרָב־כֹּחַ יִתְחַפֵּשׂ לְבוּשִׁי כְּפִי כֻתָּנְתִּי יַאַזְרֵנִי׃
rows.en: By the great force [of my disease] is my garment disfigured; It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

rows.he: הֹרָנִי לַחֹמֶר וָאֶתְמַשֵּׁל כֶּעָפָר וָאֵפֶר׃
rows.en: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.

rows.he: אֲשַׁוַּע אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא תַעֲנֵנִי עָמַדְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּנֶן בִּי׃
rows.en: I cry unto Thee, and Thou dost not answer me; I stand up, and Thou lookest at me. .

rows.he: תֵּהָפֵךְ לְאַכְזָר לִי בְּעֹצֶם יָדְךָ תִשְׂטְמֵנִי׃
rows.en: Thou art turned to be cruel to me; With the might of Thy hand Thou hatest me.

rows.he: תִּשָּׂאֵנִי אֶל־רוּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵנִי וּתְמֹגְגֵנִי תשוה [תּוּשִׁיָּה׃]
rows.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind, Thou causest me to ride upon it; And Thou dissolvest my substance.

rows.he: כִּי־יָדַעְתִּי מָוֶת תְּשִׁיבֵנִי וּבֵית מוֹעֵד לְכָל־חָי׃
rows.en: For I know that Thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.

rows.he: אַךְ לֹא־בְעִי יִשְׁלַח־יָד אִם־בְּפִידוֹ לָהֶן שׁוּעַ׃
rows.en: Surely none shall put forth his hand to a ruinous heap, Neither because of these things shall help come in one’s calamity,

rows.he: אִם־לֹא בָכִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה־יוֹם עָגְמָה נַפְשִׁי לָאֶבְיוֹן׃
rows.en: If I have not wept for him that was in trouble, And if my soul grieved not for the needy.

rows.he: כִּי טוֹב קִוִּיתִי וַיָּבֹא רָע וַאֲיַחֲלָה לְאוֹר וַיָּבֹא אֹפֶל׃
rows.en: Yet, when I looked for good, there came evil; And when I waited for light, there came darkness.

rows.he: מֵעַי רֻתְּחוּ וְלֹא־דָמּוּ קִדְּמֻנִי יְמֵי־עֹנִי׃
rows.en: Mine inwards boil, and rest not; Days of affliction are come upon me.

rows.he: קֹדֵר הִלַּכְתִּי בְּלֹא חַמָּה קַמְתִּי בַקָּהָל אֲשַׁוֵּעַ׃
rows.en: I go mourning without the sun; I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

rows.he: אָח הָיִיתִי לְתַנִּים וְרֵעַ לִבְנוֹת יַעֲנָה׃
rows.en: I am become a brother to jackals, And a companion to ostriches.

rows.he: עוֹרִי שָׁחַר מֵעָלָי וְעַצְמִי־חָרָה מִנִּי־חֹרֶב׃
rows.en: My skin is black, and falleth from me, And my bones are burned with heat.

rows.he: וַיְהִי לְאֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִי וְעֻגָבִי לְקוֹל בֹּכִים׃
rows.en: Therefore is my harp turned to mourning, And my pipe into the voice of them that weep.

rows.he: בְּרִית כָּרַתִּי לְעֵינָי וּמָה אֶתְבּוֹנֵן עַל־בְּתוּלָה׃
rows.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; How then should I look upon a maid?

rows.he: וּמֶה חֵלֶק אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְנַחֲלַת שַׁדַּי מִמְּרֹמִים׃
rows.en: For what would be the portion of God from above, And the heritage of the Almighty from on high?

rows.he: הֲלֹא־אֵיד לְעַוָּל וְנֵכֶר לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
rows.en: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, And disaster to the workers of iniquity?

rows.he: הֲלֹא־הוּא יִרְאֶה דְרָכָי וְכָל־צְעָדַי יִסְפּוֹר׃
rows.en: Doth not He see my ways, And count all my steps?

rows.he: אִם־הָלַכְתִּי עִם־שָׁוְא וַתַּחַשׁ עַל־מִרְמָה רַגְלִי׃
rows.en: If I have walked with vanity, And my foot hath hasted to deceit—

rows.he: יִשְׁקְלֵנִי בְמֹאזְנֵי־צֶדֶק וְיֵדַע אֱלוֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִי׃
rows.en: Let me be weighed in a just balance, That God may know mine integrity—

rows.he: אִם תִּטֶּה אַשֻּׁרִי מִנִּי הַדָּרֶךְ וְאַחַר עֵינַי הָלַךְ לִבִּי וּבְכַפַּי דָּבַק מֻאוּם׃
rows.en: If my step hath turned out of the way, And my heart walked after mine eyes, And if any spot hath cleaved to my hands;

rows.he: אֶזְרְעָה וְאַחֵר יֹאכֵל וְצֶאֱצָאַי יְשֹׁרָשׁוּ׃
rows.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

rows.he: אִם־נִפְתָּה לִבִּי עַל־אִשָּׁה וְעַל־פֶּתַח רֵעִי אָרָבְתִּי׃
rows.en: If my heart have been enticed unto a woman, And I have lain in wait at my neighbour’s door;

rows.he: תִּטְחַן לְאַחֵר אִשְׁתִּי וְעָלֶיהָ יִכְרְעוּן אֲחֵרִין׃
rows.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, And let others bow down upon her. .

rows.he: כִּי־הוא [הִיא] זִמָּה והיא [וְהוּא] עָוֺן פְּלִילִים׃
rows.en: For that were a heinous crime; Yea, it were an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

rows.he: כִּי אֵשׁ הִיא עַד־אֲבַדּוֹן תֹּאכֵל וּבְכָל־תְּבוּאָתִי תְשָׁרֵשׁ׃
rows.en: For it is a fire that consumeth unto destruction, And would root out all mine increase.

rows.he: אִם־אֶמְאַס מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדִּי וַאֲמָתִי בְּרִבָם עִמָּדִי׃
rows.en: If I did despise the cause of my man-servant, Or of my maid-servant, when they contended with me—

rows.he: וּמָה אֶעֱשֶׂה כִּי־יָקוּם אֵל וְכִי־יִפְקֹד מָה אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃
rows.en: What then shall I do when God riseth up? And when He remembereth, what shall I answer Him?

rows.he: הֲ‍לֹא־בַבֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂנִי עָשָׂהוּ וַיְכֻנֶנּוּ בָּרֶחֶם אֶחָד׃
rows.en: Did not He that made me in the womb make him? And did not One fashion us in the womb?

rows.he: אִם־אֶמְנַע מֵחֵפֶץ דַּלִּים וְעֵינֵי אַלְמָנָה אֲכַלֶּה׃
rows.en: If I have withheld aught that the poor desired, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

rows.he: וְאֹכַל פִּתִּי לְבַדִּי וְלֹא־אָכַל יָתוֹם מִמֶּנָּה׃
rows.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, And the fatherless hath not eaten thereof—

rows.he: כִּי מִנְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַנִי כְאָב וּמִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אַנְחֶנָּה׃
rows.en: Nay, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, And I have been her guide from my mother’s womb.

rows.he: אִם־אֶרְאֶה אוֹבֵד מִבְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וְאֵין כְּסוּת לָאֶבְיוֹן׃
rows.en: If I have seen any wanderer in want of clothing, Or that the needy had no covering;

rows.he: אִם־לֹא בֵרֲכוּנִי חלצו [חֲלָצָיו] וּמִגֵּז כְּבָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּם׃
rows.en: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

rows.he: אִם־הֲנִיפוֹתִי עַל־יָתוֹם יָדִי כִּי־אֶרְאֶה בַשַּׁעַר עֶזְרָתִי׃
rows.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, Because I saw my help in the gate;

rows.he: כְּתֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָה תִפּוֹל וְאֶזְרֹעִי מִקָּנָה תִשָּׁבֵר׃
rows.en: Then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, And mine arm be broken from the bone.

rows.he: כִּי פַחַד אֵלַי אֵיד אֵל וּמִשְּׂאֵתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל׃
rows.en: For calamity from God was a terror to me, And by reason of His majesty I could do nothing.

rows.he: אִם־שַׂמְתִּי זָהָב כִּסְלִי וְלַכֶּתֶם אָמַרְתִּי מִבְטַחִי׃
rows.en: If I have made gold my hope, And have said to the fine gold: ‘Thou art my confidence’;

rows.he: אִם־אֶשְׂמַח כִּי־רַב חֵילִי וְכִי־כַבִּיר מָצְאָה יָדִי׃
rows.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because my hand had gotten much;

rows.he: אִם־אֶרְאֶה אוֹר כִּי יָהֵל וְיָרֵחַ יָקָר הֹלֵךְ׃
rows.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, Or the moon walking in brightness;

rows.he: וַיִּפְתְּ בַּסֵּתֶר לִבִּי וַתִּשַּׁק יָדִי לְפִי׃
rows.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, And my mouth hath kissed my hand;

rows.he: גַּם־הוּא עָוֺן פְּלִילִי כִּי־כִחַשְׁתִּי לָאֵל מִמָּעַל׃
rows.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judges; For I should have lied to God that is above.

rows.he: אִם־אֶשְׂמַח בְּפִיד מְשַׂנְאִי וְהִתְעֹרַרְתִּי כִּי־מְצָאוֹ רָע׃
rows.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, Or exulted when evil found him—

rows.he: וְלֹא־נָתַתִּי לַחֲטֹא חִכִּי לִשְׁאֹל בְּאָלָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃
rows.en: Yea, I suffered not my mouth to sin By asking his life with a curse.

rows.he: אִם־לֹא אָמְרוּ מְתֵי אָהֳלִי מִי־יִתֵּן מִבְּשָׂרוֹ לֹא נִשְׂבָּע׃
rows.en: If the men of my tent said not: ‘Who can find one that hath not been satisfied with his meat?’ .

rows.he: בַּחוּץ לֹא־יָלִין גֵּר דְּלָתַי לָאֹרַח אֶפְתָּח׃
rows.en: The stranger did not lodge in the street; My doors I opened to the roadside.

rows.he: אִם־כִּסִּיתִי כְאָדָם פְּשָׁעָי לִטְמוֹן בְּחֻבִּי עֲוֺנִי׃
rows.en: If after the manner of men I covered my transgressions, By hiding mine iniquity in my bosom—

rows.he: כִּי אֶעֱרוֹץ הָמוֹן רַבָּה וּבוּז־מִשְׁפָּחוֹת יְחִתֵּנִי וָאֶדֹּם לֹא־אֵצֵא פָתַח׃
rows.en: Because I feared the great multitude, And the most contemptible among families terrified me, So that I kept silence, and went not out of the door.

rows.he: מִי יִתֶּן־לִי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי הֶן־תָּוִי שַׁדַּי יַעֲנֵנִי וְסֵפֶר כָּתַב אִישׁ רִיבִי׃
rows.en: Oh that I had one to hear me!— Lo, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me— And that I had the indictment which mine adversary hath written!

rows.he: אִם־לֹא עַל־שִׁכְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶנּוּ אֶעֶנְדֶנּוּ עֲטָרוֹת לִי׃
rows.en: Surely I would carry it upon my shoulder; I would bind it unto me as a crown.

rows.he: מִסְפַּר צְעָדַי אַגִּידֶנּוּ כְּמוֹ־נָגִיד אֲקָרֲבֶנּוּ׃
rows.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; As a prince would I go near unto him.

rows.he: אִם־עָלַי אַדְמָתִי תִזְעָק וְיַחַד תְּלָמֶיהָ יִבְכָּיוּן׃
rows.en: If my land cry out against me, And the furrows thereof weep together;

rows.he: אִם־כֹּחָהּ אָכַלְתִּי בְלִי־כָסֶף וְנֶפֶשׁ בְּעָלֶיהָ הִפָּחְתִּי׃
rows.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, Or have caused the tillers thereof to be disappointed—

rows.he: תַּחַת חִטָּה יֵצֵא חוֹחַ וְתַחַת־שְׂעֹרָה בָאְשָׁה תַּמּוּ דִּבְרֵי אִיּוֹב׃
rows.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, And noisome weeds instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

rows.he: וַיִּשְׁבְּתוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה מֵעֲנוֹת אֶת־אִיּוֹב כִּי הוּא צַדִּיק בְּעֵינָיו׃
rows.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

rows.he: וַיִּחַר אַף אֱלִיהוּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵל הַבּוּזִי מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת רָם בְּאִיּוֹב חָרָה אַפּוֹ עַל־צַדְּקוֹ נַפְשׁוֹ מֵאֱלֹהִים׃
rows.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram; against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

rows.he: וּבִשְׁלֹשֶׁת רֵעָיו חָרָה אַפּוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מָצְאוּ מַעֲנֶה וַיַּרְשִׁיעוּ אֶת־אִיּוֹב׃
rows.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

rows.he: וֶאֱלִיהוּ חִכָּה אֶת־אִיּוֹב בִּדְבָרִים כִּי זְקֵנִים־הֵמָּה מִמֶּנּוּ לְיָמִים׃
rows.en: Now Elihu had waited to speak unto Job, because they were older than he.

rows.he: וַיַּרְא אֱלִיהוּא כִּי אֵין מַעֲנֶה בְּפִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃
rows.en: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵל הַבּוּזִי וַיֹּאמַר צָעִיר אֲנִי לְיָמִים וְאַתֶּם יְשִׁישִׁים עַל־כֵּן זָחַלְתִּי וָאִירָא מֵחַוֺּת דֵּעִי אֶתְכֶם׃
rows.en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said: I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I held back, and durst not declare you mine opinion.

rows.he: אָמַרְתִּי יָמִים יְדַבֵּרוּ וְרֹב שָׁנִים יֹדִיעוּ חָכְמָה׃
rows.en: I said: ‘Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

rows.he: אָכֵן רוּחַ־הִיא בֶאֱנוֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּבִינֵם׃
rows.en: But it is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty, that giveth them understanding.

rows.he: לֹא־רַבִּים יֶחְכָּמוּ וּזְקֵנִים יָבִינוּ מִשְׁפָּט׃
rows.en: It is not the great that are wise, Nor the aged that discern judgment.

rows.he: לָכֵן אָמַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־לִּי אֲחַוֶּה דֵּעִי אַף־אָנִי׃
rows.en: Therefore I say: ‘Hearken to me; I also will declare mine opinion.’

rows.he: הֵן הוֹחַלְתִּי לְדִבְרֵיכֶם אָזִין עַד־תְּבוּנֹתֵיכֶם עַד־תַּחְקְרוּן מִלִּין׃
rows.en: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your reasons, Whilst ye searched out what to say.

rows.he: וְעָדֵיכֶם אֶתְבּוֹנָן וְהִנֵּה אֵין לְאִיּוֹב מוֹכִיחַ עוֹנֶה אֲמָרָיו מִכֶּם׃
rows.en: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none that convinced Job, Or that answered his words, among you.

rows.he: פֶּן־תֹּאמְרוּ מָצָאנוּ חָכְמָה אֵל יִדְּפֶנּוּ לֹא־אִישׁ׃
rows.en: Beware lest ye say: ‘We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not man! ’

rows.he: וְלֹא־עָרַךְ אֵלַי מִלִּין וּבְאִמְרֵיכֶם לֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃
rows.en: For he hath not directed his words against me; Neither will I answer him with your speeches.

rows.he: חַתּוּ לֹא־עָנוּ עוֹד הֶעְתִּיקוּ מֵהֶם מִלִּים׃
rows.en: They are amazed, they answer no more; Words are departed from them.

rows.he: וְהוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי־לֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ כִּי עָמְדוּ לֹא־עָנוּ עוֹד׃
rows.en: And shall I wait, because they speak not, Because they stand still, and answer no more?

rows.he: אַעֲנֶה אַף־אֲנִי חֶלְקִי אֲחַוֶּה דֵעִי אַף־אָנִי׃
rows.en: I also will answer my part, I also will declare mine opinion.

rows.he: כִּי מָלֵתִי מִלִּים הֱצִיקַתְנִי רוּחַ בִּטְנִי׃
rows.en: For I am full of words; The spirit within me constraineth me.

rows.he: הִנֵּה־בִטְנִי כְּיַיִן לֹא־יִפָּתֵחַ כְּאֹבוֹת חֲדָשִׁים יִבָּקֵעַ׃
rows.en: Behold, mine inwards are as wine which hath no vent; Like new wine-skins which are ready to burst.

rows.he: אֲדַבְּרָה וְיִרְוַח־לִי אֶפְתַּח שְׂפָתַי וְאֶעֱנֶה׃
rows.en: I will speak, that I may find relief; I will open my lips and answer.

rows.he: אַל־נָא אֶשָּׂא פְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאֶל־אָדָם לֹא אֲכַנֶּה׃
rows.en: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man’s person; Neither will I give flattering titles unto any man.

rows.he: כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֲכַנֶּה כִּמְעַט יִשָּׂאֵנִי עֹשֵׂנִי׃
rows.en: For I know not to give flattering titles; Else would my Maker soon take me away

rows.he: וְאוּלָם שְׁמַע־נָא אִיּוֹב מִלָּי וְכָל־דְּבָרַי הַאֲזִינָה׃
rows.en: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, And hearken to all my words.

rows.he: הִנֵּה־נָא פָּתַחְתִּי פִי דִּבְּרָה לְשׁוֹנִי בְחִכִּי׃
rows.en: Behold now, I have opened my mouth, My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

rows.he: יֹשֶׁר־לִבִּי אֲמָרָי וְדַעַת שְׂפָתַי בָּרוּר מִלֵּלוּ׃
rows.en: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart; And that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.

rows.he: רוּחַ־אֵל עָשָׂתְנִי וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּחַיֵּנִי׃
rows.en: The spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty given me life.

rows.he: אִם־תּוּכַל הֲשִׁיבֵנִי עֶרְכָה לְפָנַי הִתְיַצָּבָה׃
rows.en: If thou canst, answer thou me, Set thy words in order before me, stand forth.

rows.he: הֵן־אֲנִי כְפִיךָ לָאֵל מֵחֹמֶר קֹרַצְתִּי גַם־אָנִי׃
rows.en: Behold, I am toward God even as thou art; I also am formed out of the clay.

rows.he: הִנֵּה אֵמָתִי לֹא תְבַעֲתֶךָּ וְאַכְפִּי עָלֶיךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּד׃
rows.en: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.

rows.he: אַךְ אָמַרְתָּ בְאָזְנָי וְקוֹל מִלִּין אֶשְׁמָע׃
rows.en: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the voice of thy words;

rows.he: זַךְ אֲנִי בְּלִי פָשַׁע חַף אָנֹכִי וְלֹא עָוֺן לִי׃
rows.en: ’I am clean, without transgression, I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me;

rows.he: הֵן תְּנוּאוֹת עָלַי יִמְצָא יַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לוֹ׃
rows.en: Behold, He findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for His enemy;

rows.he: יָשֵׂם בַּסַּד רַגְלָי יִשְׁמֹר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָי׃
rows.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.’ .

rows.he: הֶן־זֹאת לֹא־צָדַקְתָּ אֶעֱנֶךָּ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה אֱלוֹהַ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ׃
rows.en: Behold, I answer thee: In this thou art not right, That God is too great for man;

rows.he: מַדּוּעַ אֵלָיו רִיבוֹתָ כִּי כָל־דְּבָרָיו לֹא־יַעֲנֶה׃
rows.en: Why hast thou striven against Him? Seeing that He will not answer any of his words.

rows.he: כִּי־בְאַחַת יְדַבֶּר־אֵל וּבִשְׁתַּיִם לֹא יְשׁוּרֶנָּה׃
rows.en: For God speaketh in one way, Yea in two, though man perceiveth it not.

rows.he: בַּחֲלוֹם חֶזְיוֹן לַיְלָה בִּנְפֹל תַּרְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁים בִּתְנוּמוֹת עֲלֵי מִשְׁכָּב׃
rows.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;

rows.he: אָז יִגְלֶה אֹזֶן אֲנָשִׁים וּבְמֹסָרָם יַחְתֹּם׃
rows.en: Then He openeth the ears of men, And by their chastisement sealeth the decree,

rows.he: לְהָסִיר אָדָם מַעֲשֶׂה וְגֵוָה מִגֶּבֶר יְכַסֶּה׃
rows.en: That men may put away their purpose, And that He may hide pride from man;

rows.he: יַחְשֹׂךְ נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁחַת וְחַיָּתוֹ מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁלַח׃
rows.en: That He may keep back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.

rows.he: וְהוּכַח בְּמַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וריב [וְרוֹב] עֲצָמָיו אֵתָן׃
rows.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And all his bones grow stiff;

rows.he: וְזִהֲמַתּוּ חַיָּתוֹ לָחֶם וְנַפְשׁוֹ מַאֲכַל תַּאֲוָה׃
rows.en: So that his life maketh him to abhor bread, And his soul dainty food.

rows.he: יִכֶל בְּשָׂרוֹ מֵרֹאִי ושפי [וְשֻׁפּוּ] עַצְמוֹתָיו לֹא רֻאּוּ׃
rows.en: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones corrode to unsightliness.

rows.he: וַתִּקְרַב לַשַּׁחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְחַיָּתוֹ לַמְמִתִים׃
rows.en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, And his life to the destroyers.

rows.he: אִם־יֵשׁ עָלָיו מַלְאָךְ מֵלִיץ אֶחָד מִנִּי־אָלֶף לְהַגִּיד לְאָדָם יָשְׁרוֹ׃
rows.en: If there be for him an angel, An intercessor, one among a thousand, To vouch for a man’s uprightness;

rows.he: וַיְחֻנֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר פְּדָעֵהוּ מֵרֶדֶת שָׁחַת מָצָאתִי כֹפֶר׃
rows.en: Then He is gracious unto him, and saith: ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

rows.he: רֻטֲפַשׁ בְּשָׂרוֹ מִנֹּעַר יָשׁוּב לִימֵי עֲלוּמָיו׃
rows.en: His flesh is tenderer than a child’s; He returneth to the days of his youth;

rows.he: יֶעְתַּר אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ וַיִּרְצֵהוּ וַיַּרְא פָּנָיו בִּתְרוּעָה וַיָּשֶׁב לֶאֱנוֹשׁ צִדְקָתוֹ׃
rows.en: He prayeth unto God, and He is favourable unto him; So that he seeth His face with joy; And He restoreth unto man his righteousness.

rows.he: יָשֹׁר עַל־אֲנָשִׁים וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי וְיָשָׁר הֶעֱוֵיתִי וְלֹא־שָׁוָה לִי׃
rows.en: He cometh before men, and saith: ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not.’

rows.he: פָּדָה נפשי [נַפְשׁוֹ] מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁחַת וחיתי [וְחַיָּתוֹ] בָּאוֹר תִּרְאֶה׃
rows.en: So He redeemeth his soul from going into the pit, And his life beholdeth the light.

rows.he: הֶן־כָּל־אֵלֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵל פַּעֲמַיִם שָׁלוֹשׁ עִם־גָּבֶר׃
rows.en: Lo, all these things doth God work, Twice, yea thrice, with a man,

rows.he: לְהָשִׁיב נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁחַת לֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים׃
rows.en: To bring back his soul from the pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

rows.he: הַקְשֵׁב אִיּוֹב שְׁמַע־לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר׃
rows.en: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me; Hold thy peace, and I will speak.

rows.he: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּין הֲשִׁיבֵנִי דַּבֵּר כִּי־חָפַצְתִּי צַדְּקֶךָּ׃
rows.en: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me; Speak, for I desire to justify thee.

rows.he: אִם־אַיִן אַתָּה שְׁמַע־לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ חָכְמָה׃
rows.en: If not, hearken thou unto me; Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּא וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Moreover Elihu answered and said:

rows.he: שִׁמְעוּ חֲכָמִים מִלָּי וְיֹדְעִים הַאֲזִינוּ לִי׃
rows.en: Hear my words, ye wise men; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

rows.he: כִּי־אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ יִטְעַם לֶאֱכֹל׃
rows.en: For the ear trieth words, As the palate tasteth food.

rows.he: מִשְׁפָּט נִבְחֲרָה־לָּנוּ נֵדְעָה בֵינֵינוּ מַה־טּוֹב׃
rows.en: Let us choose for us that which is right; Let us know among ourselves what is good.

rows.he: כִּי־אָמַר אִיּוֹב צָדַקְתִּי וְאֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִי׃
rows.en: For Job hath said: ‘I am righteous, And God hath taken away my right;

rows.he: עַל־מִשְׁפָּטִי אֲכַזֵּב אָנוּשׁ חִצִּי בְלִי־פָשַׁע׃
rows.en: Notwithstanding my right I am accounted a liar; My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.’

rows.he: מִי־גֶבֶר כְּאִיּוֹב יִשְׁתֶּה־לַּעַג כַּמָּיִם׃
rows.en: What man is like Job, Who drinketh up scorning like water?

rows.he: וְאָרַח לְחֶבְרָה עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וְלָלֶכֶת עִם־אַנְשֵׁי־רֶשַׁע׃
rows.en: Who goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men.

rows.he: כִּי־אָמַר לֹא יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר בִּרְצֹתוֹ עִם־אֱלֹהִים׃
rows.en: For he hath said: ‘It profiteth a man nothing That he should be in accord with God.’

rows.he: לָכֵן אַנֲשֵׁי לֵבָב שִׁמְעוּ לִי חָלִלָה לָאֵל מֵרֶשַׁע וְשַׁדַּי מֵעָוֶל׃
rows.en: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that He should do wickedness; And from the Almighty, that He should commit iniquity.

rows.he: כִּי פֹעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ וּכְאֹרַח אִישׁ יַמְצִאֶנּוּ׃
rows.en: For the work of a man will He requite unto him, And cause every man to find according to his ways.

rows.he: אַף־אָמְנָם אֵל לֹא־יַרְשִׁיעַ וְשַׁדַּי לֹא־יְעַוֵּת מִשְׁפָּט׃
rows.en: Yea, of a surety, God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

rows.he: מִי־פָקַד עָלָיו אָרְצָה וּמִי שָׂם תֵּבֵל כֻּלָּהּ׃
rows.en: Who gave Him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?

rows.he: אִם־יָשִׂים אֵלָיו לִבּוֹ רוּחוֹ וְנִשְׁמָתוֹ אֵלָיו יֶאֱסֹף׃
rows.en: If He set His heart upon man, If He gather unto Himself his spirit and his breath;

rows.he: יִגְוַע כָּל־בָּשָׂר יָחַד וְאָדָם עַל־עָפָר יָשׁוּב׃
rows.en: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall return unto dust.

rows.he: וְאִם־בִּינָה שִׁמְעָה־זֹּאת הַאֲזִינָה לְקוֹל מִלָּי׃
rows.en: If now thou hast understanding, hear this; Hearken to the voice of my words.

rows.he: הַאַף שׂוֹנֵא מִשְׁפָּט יַחֲבוֹשׁ וְאִם־צַדִּיק כַּבִּיר תַּרְשִׁיעַ׃
rows.en: Shall even one that hateth right govern? And wilt thou condemn Him that is just and mighty—

rows.he: הַאֲמֹר לְמֶלֶךְ בְּלִיָּעַל רָשָׁע אֶל־נְדִיבִים׃
rows.en: Is it fit to say to a king: ‘Thou art base’? Or to nobles: ‘Ye are wicked’?—

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא פְּנֵי שָׂרִים וְלֹא נִכַּר־שׁוֹעַ לִפְנֵי־דָל כִּי־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו כֻּלָּם׃
rows.en: That respecteth not the persons of princes, Nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? For they all are the work of His hands.

rows.he: רֶגַע יָמֻתוּ וַחֲצוֹת לָיְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁוּ עָם וְיַעֲבֹרוּ וְיָסִירוּ אַבִּיר לֹא בְיָד׃
rows.en: In a moment they die, even at midnight; The people are shaken and pass away, And the mighty are taken away without hand. .

rows.he: כִּי־עֵינָיו עַל־דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ וְכָל־צְעָדָיו יִרְאֶה׃
rows.en: For His eyes are upon the ways of a man, And He seeth all his goings.

rows.he: אֵין־חֹשֶׁךְ וְאֵין צַלְמָוֶת לְהִסָּתֶר שָׁם פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
rows.en: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

rows.he: כִּי לֹא עַל־אִישׁ יָשִׂים עוֹד לַהֲלֹךְ אֶל־אֵל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃
rows.en: For He doth not appoint a time unto any man, When he should go before God in judgment.

rows.he: יָרֹעַ כַּבִּירִים לֹא־חֵקֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד אֲחֵרִים תַּחְתָּם׃
rows.en: He breaketh in pieces mighty men without inquisition, And setteth others in their stead.

rows.he: לָכֵן יַכִּיר מַעְבָּדֵיהֶם וְהָפַךְ לַיְלָה וְיִדַּכָּאוּ׃
rows.en: Therefore He taketh knowledge of their works; And He overturneth them in the night, so that they are crushed.

rows.he: תַּחַת־רְשָׁעִים סְפָקָם בִּמְקוֹם רֹאִים׃
rows.en: He striketh them as wicked men In the open sight of others;

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר עַל־כֵּן סָרוּ מֵאַחֲרָיו וְכָל־דְּרָכָיו לֹא הִשְׂכִּילוּ׃
rows.en: Because they turned aside from following Him, And would not have regard to any of His ways;

rows.he: לְהָבִיא עָלָיו צַעֲקַת־דָּל וְצַעֲקַת עֲנִיִּים יִשְׁמָע׃
rows.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto Him, And He heareth the cry of the afflicted.

rows.he: וְהוּא יַשְׁקִט וּמִי יַרְשִׁעַ וְיַסְתֵּר פָּנִים וּמִי יְשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְעַל־גּוֹי וְעַל־אָדָם יָחַד׃
rows.en: When He giveth quietness, who then can condemn? And when He hideth His face, who then can behold Him? Whether it be done unto a nation, or unto a man, alike;

rows.he: מִמְּלֹךְ אָדָם חָנֵף מִמֹּקְשֵׁי עָם׃
rows.en: That the godless man reign not, That there be none to ensnare the people.

rows.he: כִּי־אֶל־אֵל הֶאָמַר נָשָׂאתִי לֹא אֶחְבֹּל׃
rows.en: For hath any said unto God: ‘I have borne chastisement, though I offend not;

rows.he: בִּלְעֲדֵי אֶחֱזֶה אַתָּה הֹרֵנִי אִם־עָוֶל פָּעַלְתִּי לֹא אֹסִיף׃
rows.en: That which I see not teach Thou me; If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

rows.he: הַמֵעִמְּךָ יְשַׁלְמֶנָּה כִּי־מָאַסְתָּ כִּי־אַתָּה תִבְחַר וְלֹא־אָנִי וּמַה־יָדַעְתָּ דַבֵּר׃
rows.en: Shall His recompense be as thou wilt? For thou loathest it, So that thou must choose, and not I; Therefore speak what thou knowest.

rows.he: אַנְשֵׁי לֵבָב יֹאמְרוּ לִי וְגֶבֶר חָכָם שֹׁמֵעַ לִי׃
rows.en: Men of understanding will say unto me, Yea, every wise man that heareth me:

rows.he: אִיּוֹב לֹא־בְדַעַת יְדַבֵּר וּדְבָרָיו לֹא בְהַשְׂכֵּיל׃
rows.en: ’Job speaketh without knowledge, And his words are without discernment.’

rows.he: אָבִי יִבָּחֵן אִיּוֹב עַד־נֶצַח עַל־תְּשֻׁבֹת בְּאַנְשֵׁי־אָוֶן׃
rows.en: Would that Job were tried unto the end, Because of his answering like wicked men.

rows.he: כִּי יֹסִיף עַל־חַטָּאתוֹ פֶשַׁע בֵּינֵינוּ יִסְפּוֹק וְיֶרֶב אֲמָרָיו לָאֵל׃
rows.en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, He clappeth his hands among us, And multiplieth his words against God.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּ וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Moreover Elihu answered and said:

rows.he: הֲזֹאת חָשַׁבְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּט אָמַרְתָּ צִדְקִי מֵאֵל׃
rows.en: Thinkest thou this to be thy right, Or sayest thou: ‘I am righteousness before God’,

rows.he: כִּי־תֹאמַר מַה־יִּסְכָּן־לָךְ מָה־אֹעִיל מֵחַטָּאתִי׃
rows.en: That thou inquirest: ‘What advantage will it be unto Thee?’ And: ‘What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?’

rows.he: אֲנִי אֲשִׁיבְךָ מִלִּין וְאֶת־רֵעֶיךָ עִמָּךְ׃
rows.en: I will give thee answer, And thy companions with thee.

rows.he: הַבֵּט שָׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וְשׁוּר שְׁחָקִים גָּבְהוּ מִמֶּךָּ׃
rows.en: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the skies, which are higher than thou.

rows.he: אִם־חָטָאתָ מַה־תִּפְעָל־בּוֹ וְרַבּוּ פְשָׁעֶיךָ מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ׃
rows.en: If thou hast sinned, what doest thou against Him? And if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto Him?

rows.he: אִם־צָדַקְתָּ מַה־תִּתֶּן־לוֹ אוֹ מַה־מִיָּדְךָ יִקָּח׃
rows.en: If thou be righteous, what givest thou Him? Or what receiveth He of thy hand?

rows.he: לְאִישׁ־כָּמוֹךָ רִשְׁעֶךָ וּלְבֶן־אָדָם צִדְקָתֶךָ׃
rows.en: Thy wickedness concerneth a man as thou art; And thy righteousness a son of man.

rows.he: מֵרֹב עֲשׁוּקִים יַזְעִיקוּ יְשַׁוְּעוּ מִזְּרוֹעַ רַבִּים׃
rows.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

rows.he: וְלֹא־אָמַר אַיֵּה אֱלוֹהַּ עֹשָׂי נֹתֵן זְמִרוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה׃
rows.en: But none saith: ‘Where is God my Maker, Who giveth songs in the night;

rows.he: מַלְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמוֹת אָרֶץ וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יְחַכְּמֵנוּ׃
rows.en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?’

rows.he: שָׁם יִצְעֲקוּ וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה מִפְּנֵי גְּאוֹן רָעִים׃
rows.en: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.

rows.he: אַךְ־שָׁוְא לֹא־יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְשַׁדַּי לֹא יְשׁוּרֶנָּה׃
rows.en: Surely God will not hear vanity, Neither will the Almighty regard it.

rows.he: אַף כִּי־תֹאמַר לֹא תְשׁוּרֶנּוּ דִּין לְפָנָיו וּתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ׃
rows.en: Yea, when thou sayest thou canst not see Him— The cause is before Him; therefore wait thou for Him.

rows.he: וְעַתָּה כִּי־אַיִן פָּקַד אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָדַע בַּפַּשׁ מְאֹד׃
rows.en: And now, is it for nought that He punished in His anger? And hath He not full knowledge of arrogance?

rows.he: וְאִיּוֹב הֶבֶל יִפְצֶה־פִּיהוּ בִּבְלִי־דַעַת מִלִּין יַכְבִּר׃
rows.en: But Job doth open his mouth in vanity; He multiplieth words without knowledge.

rows.he: וַיֹּסֶף אֱלִיהוּא וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Elihu also proceeded, and said:

rows.he: כַּתַּר־לִי זְעֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּךָּ כִּי עוֹד לֶאֱלוֹהַּ מִלִּים׃
rows.en: Suffer me a little, and I will tell thee; For there are yet words on God’s behalf.

rows.he: אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי לְמֵרָחוֹק וּלְפֹעֲלִי אֶתֵּן־צֶדֶק׃
rows.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

rows.he: כִּי־אָמְנָם לֹא־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּי תְּמִים דֵּעוֹת עִמָּךְ׃
rows.en: For truly my words are not false; One that is upright in mind is with thee.

rows.he: הֶן־אֵל כַּבִּיר וְלֹא יִמְאָס כַּבִּיר כֹּחַ לֵב׃
rows.en: Behold, God is mighty, yet He despiseth not any; He is mighty in strength of understanding.

rows.he: לֹא־יְחַיֶּה רָשָׁע וּמִשְׁפַּט עֲנִיִּים יִתֵּן׃
rows.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked; But giveth to the poor their right.

rows.he: לֹא־יִגְרַע מִצַּדִּיק עֵינָיו וְאֶת־מְלָכִים לַכִּסֵּא וַיֹּשִׁיבֵם לָנֶצַח וַיִּגְבָּהוּ׃
rows.en: He withdraweth not His eyes from the righteous; But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.

rows.he: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִים בַּזִּקִּים יִלָּכְדוּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹנִי׃
rows.en: And if they be bound in fetters, And be holden in cords of affliction;

rows.he: וַיַּגֵּד לָהֶם פָּעֳלָם וּפִשְׁעֵיהֶם כִּי יִתְגַּבָּרוּ׃
rows.en: Then He declareth unto them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

rows.he: וַיִּגֶל אָזְנָם לַמּוּסָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יְשֻׁבוּן מֵאָוֶן׃
rows.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.

rows.he: אִם־יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיַעֲבֹדוּ יְכַלּוּ יְמֵיהֶם בַּטּוֹב וּשְׁנֵיהֶם בַּנְּעִימִים׃
rows.en: If they hearken and serve Him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.

rows.he: וְאִם־לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁלַח יַעֲבֹרוּ וְיִגְוְעוּ כִּבְלִי־דָעַת׃
rows.en: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.

rows.he: וְחַנְפֵי־לֵב יָשִׂימוּ אָף לֹא יְשַׁוְּעוּ כִּי אֲסָרָם׃
rows.en: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger; They cry not for help when He bindeth them.

rows.he: תָּמֹת בַּנֹּעַר נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם בַּקְּדֵשִׁים׃
rows.en: Their soul perisheth in youth, And their life as that of the depraved.

rows.he: יְחַלֵּץ עָנִי בְעָנְיוֹ וְיִגֶל בַּלַּחַץ אָזְנָם׃
rows.en: He delivereth the afflicted by His affliction, And openeth their ear by tribulation.

rows.he: וְאַף הֲסִיתְךָ מִפִּי־צָר רַחַב לֹא־מוּצָק תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְנַחַת שֻׁלְחָנְךָ מָלֵא דָשֶׁן׃
rows.en: Yea, He hath allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table is full of fatness;

rows.he: וְדִין־רָשָׁע מָלֵאתָ דִּין וּמִשְׁפָּט יִתְמֹכוּ׃
rows.en: And thou art full of the judgment of the wicked; Judgment and justice take hold on them.

rows.he: כִּי־חֵמָה פֶּן־יְסִיתְךָ בְסָפֶק וְרָב־כֹּפֶר אַל־יַטֶּךָּ׃
rows.en: For beware of wrath, lest thou be led away by thy sufficiency; Neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.

rows.he: הֲיַעֲרֹךְ שׁוּעֲךָ לֹא בְצָר וְכֹל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹחַ׃
rows.en: Will thy riches avail, that are without stint, Or all the forces of thy strength?

rows.he: אַל־תִּשְׁאַף הַלָּיְלָה לַעֲלוֹת עַמִּים תַּחְתָּם׃
rows.en: Desire not the night, When peoples are cut off in their place.

rows.he: הִשָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּפֶן אֶל־אָוֶן כִּי־עַל־זֶה בָּחַרְתָּ מֵעֹנִי׃
rows.en: Take heed, regard not iniquity; For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

rows.he: הֶן־אֵל יַשְׂגִּיב בְּכֹחוֹ מִי כָמֹהוּ מוֹרֶה׃
rows.en: Behold, God doeth loftily in His power; Who is a teacher like Him?

rows.he: מִי־פָקַד עָלָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וּמִי־אָמַר פָּעַלְתָּ עַוְלָה׃
rows.en: Who hath enjoined Him His way? Or who hath said: ‘Thou hast wrought unrighteousness’?

rows.he: זְכֹר כִּי־תַשְׂגִּיא פָעֳלוֹ אֲשֶׁר שֹׁרְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים׃
rows.en: Remember that thou magnify His work, Whereof men have sung.

rows.he: כָּל־אָדָם חָזוּ־בוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ יַבִּיט מֵרָחוֹק׃
rows.en: All men have looked thereon; Man beholdeth it afar off.

rows.he: הֶן־אֵל שַׂגִּיא וְלֹא נֵדָע מִסְפַּר שָׁנָיו וְלֹא־חֵקֶר׃
rows.en: Behold, God is great, beyond our knowledge; The number of His years is unsearchable.

rows.he: כִּי יְגָרַע נִטְפֵי־מָיִם יָזֹקּוּ מָטָר לְאֵדוֹ׃
rows.en: For He draweth away the drops of water, Which distil rain from His vapour;

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר־יִזְּלוּ שְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ עֲלֵי אָדָם רָב׃
rows.en: Which the skies pour down And drop upon the multitudes of men.

rows.he: אַף אִם־יָבִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָב תְּשֻׁאוֹת סֻכָּתוֹ׃
rows.en: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, The crashings of His pavilion?

rows.he: הֵן־פָּרַשׂ עָלָיו אוֹרוֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁי הַיָּם כִּסָּה׃
rows.en: Behold, He spreadeth His light upon it; And He covereth the depths of the sea.

rows.he: כִּי־בָם יָדִין עַמִּים יִתֶּן־אֹכֶל לְמַכְבִּיר׃
rows.en: For by these He judgeth the peoples; He giveth food in abundance.

rows.he: עַל־כַּפַּיִם כִּסָּה־אוֹר וַיְצַו עָלֶיהָ בְמַפְגִּיעַ׃
rows.en: He covereth His hands with the lightning, And giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.

rows.he: יַגִּיד עָלָיו רֵעוֹ מִקְנֶה אַף עַל־עוֹלֶה׃
rows.en: The noise thereof telleth concerning it, The cattle also concerning the storm that cometh up.

rows.he: אַף־לְזֹאת יֶחֱרַד לִבִּי וְיִתַּר מִמְּקוֹמוֹ׃
rows.en: At this also my heart trembleth, And is moved out of its place.

rows.he: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ בְּרֹגֶז קֹלוֹ וְהֶגֶה מִפִּיו יֵצֵא׃
rows.en: Hear attentively the noise of His voice, And the sound that goeth out of His mouth.

rows.he: תַּחַת־כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁרֵהוּ וְאוֹרוֹ עַל־כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
rows.en: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, And His lightning unto the ends of the earth.

rows.he: אַחֲרָיו יִשְׁאַג־קוֹל יַרְעֵם בְּקוֹל גְּאוֹנוֹ וְלֹא יְעַקְּבֵם כִּי־יִשָּׁמַע קוֹלוֹ׃
rows.en: After it a voice roareth; He thundereth with the voice of His majesty; And He stayeth them not when His voice is heard.

rows.he: יַרְעֵם אֵל בְּקוֹלוֹ נִפְלָאוֹת עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת וְלֹא נֵדָע׃
rows.en: God thundereth marvellously with His voice; Great things doeth He, which we cannot comprehend.

rows.he: כִּי לַשֶּׁלַג יֹאמַר הֱוֵא אָרֶץ וְגֶשֶׁם מָטָר וְגֶשֶׁם מִטְרוֹת עֻזּוֹ׃
rows.en: For He saith to the snow: ‘Fall thou on the earth’; Likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of His mighty rain.

rows.he: בְּיַד־כָּל־אָדָם יַחְתּוֹם לָדַעַת כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי מַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃
rows.en: He sealeth up the hand of every man, That all men whom He hath made may know it.

rows.he: וַתָּבֹא חַיָּה בְמוֹ־אָרֶב וּבִמְעוֹנֹתֶיהָ תִשְׁכֹּן׃
rows.en: Then the beasts go into coverts, And remain in their dens.

rows.he: מִן־הַחֶדֶר תָּבוֹא סוּפָה וּמִמְּזָרִים קָרָה׃
rows.en: Out of the Chamber cometh the storm; And cold out of the north.

rows.he: מִנִּשְׁמַת־אֵל יִתֶּן־קָרַח וְרֹחַב מַיִם בְּמוּצָק׃
rows.en: By the breath of God ice is given, And the breadth of the waters is straitened.

rows.he: אַף־בְּרִי יַטְרִיחַ עָב יָפִיץ עֲנַן אוֹרוֹ׃
rows.en: Yea, He ladeth the thick cloud with moister, He spreadeth abroad the cloud of His lightning;

rows.he: וְהוּא מְסִבּוֹת מִתְהַפֵּךְ בתחבולתו [בְּתַחְבּוּלֹתָיו] לְפָעֳלָם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֵּם עַל־פְּנֵי תֵבֵל אָרְצָה׃
rows.en: And they are turned round about by His guidance, That they may do whatsoever He commandeth them Upon the face of the habitable world:

rows.he: אִם־לְשֵׁבֶט אִם־לְאַרְצוֹ אִם־לְחֶסֶד יַמְצִאֵהוּ׃
rows.en: Whether it be for correction, or for His earth, Or for mercy, that He cause it to come.

rows.he: הַאֲזִינָה זֹּאת אִיּוֹב עֲמֹד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵן נִפְלְאוֹת אֵל׃
rows.en: Hearken unto this, O Job; Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

rows.he: הֲתֵדַע בְּשׂוּם־אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶם וְהוֹפִיעַ אוֹר עֲנָנוֹ׃
rows.en: Dost thou know how God enjoineth them, And causeth the lightning of His cloud to shine?

rows.he: הֲתֵדַע עַל־מִפְלְשֵׂי־עָב מִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִים׃
rows.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of Him who is perfect in knowledge?

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר־בְּגָדֶיךָ חַמִּים בְּהַשְׁקִט אֶרֶץ מִדָּרוֹם׃
rows.en: Thou whose garments are warm, When the earth is still by reason of the south wind;

rows.he: תַּרְקִיעַ עִמּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִים חֲזָקִים כִּרְאִי מוּצָק׃
rows.en: Canst thou with Him spread out the sky, Which is strong as a molten mirror?

rows.he: הוֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־נֹּאמַר לוֹ לֹא־נַעֲרֹךְ מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ׃
rows.en: Teach us what we shall say unto Him; For we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

rows.he: הַיְסֻפַּר־לוֹ כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אִם־אָמַר אִישׁ כִּי יְבֻלָּע׃
rows.en: Shall it be told Him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

rows.he: וְעַתָּה לֹא רָאוּ אוֹר בָּהִיר הוּא בַּשְּׁחָקִים וְרוּחַ עָבְרָה וַתְּטַהֲרֵם׃
rows.en: And now men see not the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

rows.he: מִצָּפוֹן זָהָב יֶאֱתֶה עַל־אֱלוֹהַּ נוֹרָא הוֹד׃
rows.en: Out of the north cometh golden splendour, About God is terrible majesty.

rows.he: שַׁדַּי לֹא־מְצָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא־כֹחַ וּמִשְׁפָּט וְרֹב־צְדָקָה לֹא יְעַנֶּה׃
rows.en: The Almighty, whom we cannot find out, is excellent in power, Yet to judgment and plenteous justice He doeth no violence.

rows.he: לָכֵן יְרֵאוּהוּ אֲנָשִׁים לֹא־יִרְאֶה כָּל־חַכְמֵי־לֵב׃
rows.en: Men do therefore fear Him; He regardeth not any that are wise of heart.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן־יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב מנ הסערה [מִן ] [הַסְּעָרָה] וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:

rows.he: מִי זֶה מַחְשִׁיךְ עֵצָה בְמִלִּין בְּלִי־דָעַת׃
rows.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel By words without knowledge?

rows.he: אֱזָר־נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ וְאֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
rows.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto Me.

rows.he: אֵיפֹה הָיִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי־אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם־יָדַעְתָּ בִינָה׃
rows.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast the understanding.

rows.he: מִי־שָׂם מְמַדֶּיהָ כִּי תֵדָע אוֹ מִי־נָטָה עָלֶיהָ קָּו׃
rows.en: Who determined the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who stretched the line upon it?

rows.he: עַל־מָה אֲדָנֶיהָ הָטְבָּעוּ אוֹ מִי־יָרָה אֶבֶן פִּנָּתָהּ׃
rows.en: Whereupon were the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner-stone thereof,

rows.he: בְּרָן־יַחַד כּוֹכְבֵי בֹקֶר וַיָּרִיעוּ כָּל־בְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
rows.en: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

rows.he: וַיָּסֶךְ בִּדְלָתַיִם יָם בְּגִיחוֹ מֵרֶחֶם יֵצֵא׃
