rows.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, When it broke forth, and issued out of the womb;

rows.he: בְּשׂוּמִי עָנָן לְבֻשׁוֹ וַעֲרָפֶל חֲתֻלָּתוֹ׃
rows.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, And thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

rows.he: וָאֶשְׁבֹּר עָלָיו חֻקִּי וָאָשִׂים בְּרִיחַ וּדְלָתָיִם׃
rows.en: And prescribed for it My decree, And set bars and doors,

rows.he: וָאֹמַר עַד־פֹּה תָבוֹא וְלֹא תֹסִיף וּפֹא־יָשִׁית בִּגְאוֹן גַּלֶּיךָ׃
rows.en: And said: ‘Thus far shalt thou come, but no further; And here shall thy proud waves be stayed’?

rows.he: הְמִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּיתָ בֹּקֶר ידעתה שחר [יִדַּעְתָּה] [הַשַּׁחַר] מְקֹמוֹ׃
rows.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days began, And caused the dayspring to know its place;

rows.he: לֶאֱחֹז בְּכַנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ וְיִנָּעֲרוּ רְשָׁעִים מִמֶּנָּה׃
rows.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?

rows.he: תִּתְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹמֶר חוֹתָם וְיִתְיַצְּבוּ כְּמוֹ לְבוּשׁ׃
rows.en: It is changed as clay under the seal; And they stand as a garment.

rows.he: וְיִמָּנַע מֵרְשָׁעִים אוֹרָם וּזְרוֹעַ רָמָה תִּשָּׁבֵר׃
rows.en: But from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm is broken.

rows.he: הֲבָאתָ עַד־נִבְכֵי־יָם וּבְחֵקֶר תְּהוֹם הִתְהַלָּכְתָּ׃
rows.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep? .

rows.he: הֲנִגְלוּ לְךָ שַׁעֲרֵי־מָוֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵי צַלְמָוֶת תִּרְאֶה׃
rows.en: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? Or hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?

rows.he: הִתְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד־רַחֲבֵי־אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם־יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּהּ׃
rows.en: Hast thou surveyed unto the breadths of the earth? Declare, if thou knowest it all.

rows.he: אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן־אוֹר וְחֹשֶׁךְ אֵי־זֶה מְקֹמוֹ׃
rows.en: Where is the way to the dwelling of light, And as for darkness, where is the place thereof;

rows.he: כִּי תִקָּחֶנּוּ אֶל־גְּבוּלוֹ וְכִי־תָבִין נְתִיבוֹת בֵּיתוֹ׃
rows.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, And that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

rows.he: יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־אָז תִּוָּלֵד וּמִסְפַּר יָמֶיךָ רַבִּים׃
rows.en: Thou knowest it, for thou wast then born, And the number of thy days is great!

rows.he: הֲבָאתָ אֶל־אֹצְרוֹת שָׁלֶג וְאֹצְרוֹת בָּרָד תִּרְאֶה׃
rows.en: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow, Or hast thou seen the treasuries of the hail,

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר־חָשַׂכְתִּי לְעֶת־צָר לְיוֹם קְרָב וּמִלְחָמָה׃
rows.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, Against the day of battle and war?

rows.he: אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יֵחָלֶק אוֹר יָפֵץ קָדִים עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ׃
rows.en: By what way is the light parted, Or the east wind scattered upon the earth?

rows.he: מִי־פִלַּג לַשֶּׁטֶף תְּעָלָה וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלוֹת׃
rows.en: Who hath cleft a channel for the waterflood, Or a way for the lightning of the thunder;

rows.he: לְהַמְטִיר עַל־אֶרֶץ לֹא־אִישׁ מִדְבָּר לֹא־אָדָם בּוֹ׃
rows.en: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is, On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

rows.he: לְהַשְׂבִּיעַ שֹׁאָה וּמְשֹׁאָה וּלְהַצְמִיחַ מֹצָא דֶשֶׁא׃
rows.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground, And to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

rows.he: הֲיֵשׁ־לַמָּטָר אָב אוֹ מִי־הוֹלִיד אֶגְלֵי־טָל׃
rows.en: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

rows.he: מִבֶּטֶן מִי יָצָא הַקָּרַח וּכְפֹר שָׁמַיִם מִי יְלָדוֹ׃
rows.en: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoar-frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

rows.he: כָּאֶבֶן מַיִם יִתְחַבָּאוּ וּפְנֵי תְהוֹם יִתְלַכָּדוּ׃
rows.en: The waters are congealed like stone, And the face of the deep is frozen.

rows.he: הַתְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּוֹת כִּימָה אוֹ־מֹשְׁכוֹת כְּסִיל תְּפַתֵּחַ׃
rows.en: Canst thou bind the chains of the Pleiades, Or loose the bands of Orion?

rows.he: הֲתֹצִיא מַזָּרוֹת בְּעִתּוֹ וְעַיִשׁ עַל־בָּנֶיהָ תַנְחֵם׃
rows.en: Canst thou lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season? Or canst thou guide the Bear with her sons?

rows.he: הֲיָדַעְתָּ חֻקּוֹת שָׁמָיִם אִם־תָּשִׂים מִשְׁטָרוֹ בָאָרֶץ׃
rows.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? Canst thou establish the dominion thereof in the earth?

rows.he: הֲתָרִים לָעָב קוֹלֶךָ וְשִׁפְעַת־מַיִם תְּכַסֶּךָּ׃
rows.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover thee?

rows.he: הַתְשַׁלַּח בְּרָקִים וְיֵלֵכוּ וְיֹאמְרוּ לְךָ הִנֵּנוּ׃
rows.en: Canst thou send forth lightnings, that they may go, And say unto thee: ‘Here we are’?

rows.he: מִי־שָׁת בַּטֻּחוֹת חָכְמָה אוֹ מִי־נָתַן לַשֶּׂכְוִי בִינָה׃
rows.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the mind?

rows.he: מִי־יְסַפֵּר שְׁחָקִים בְּחָכְמָה וְנִבְלֵי שָׁמַיִם מִי יַשְׁכִּיב׃
rows.en: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,

rows.he: בְּצֶקֶת עָפָר לַמּוּצָק וּרְגָבִים יְדֻבָּקוּ׃
rows.en: When the dust runneth into a mass, And the clods cleave fast together?

rows.he: הֲתָצוּד לְלָבִיא טָרֶף וְחַיַּת כְּפִירִים תְּמַלֵּא׃
rows.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lioness? Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

rows.he: כִּי־יָשֹׁחוּ בַמְּעוֹנוֹת יֵשְׁבוּ בַסֻּכָּה לְמוֹ־אָרֶב׃
rows.en: When they couch in their dens, And abide in the covert to lie in wait?

rows.he: מִי יָכִין לָעֹרֵב צֵידוֹ כִּי־ילדו [יְלָדָיו] אֶל־אֵל יְשַׁוֵּעוּ יִתְעוּ לִבְלִי־אֹכֶל׃
rows.en: Who provideth for the raven his prey, When his young ones cry unto God, and wander for lack of food?

rows.he: הֲיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לֶדֶת יַעֲלֵי־סָלַע חֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר׃
rows.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

rows.he: תִּסְפֹּר יְרָחִים תְּמַלֶּאנָה וְיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לִדְתָּנָה׃
rows.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

rows.he: תִּכְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶן תְּפַלַּחְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶם תְּשַׁלַּחְנָה׃
rows.en: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young, They cast out their fruit.

rows.he: יַחְלְמוּ בְנֵיהֶם יִרְבּוּ בַבָּר יָצְאוּ וְלֹא־שָׁבוּ לָמוֹ׃
rows.en: Their young ones wax strong, they grow up in the open field; They go forth, and return not again.

rows.he: מִי־שִׁלַּח פֶּרֶא חָפְשִׁי וּמֹסְרוֹת עָרוֹד מִי פִתֵּחַ׃
rows.en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? Or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂמְתִּי עֲרָבָה בֵיתוֹ וּמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו מְלֵחָה׃
rows.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness, And the salt land his dwelling-place.

rows.he: יִשְׂחַק לַהֲמוֹן קִרְיָה תְּשֻׁאוֹת נוֹגֵשׂ לֹא יִשְׁמָע׃
rows.en: He scorneth the tumult of the city, Neither heareth he the shoutings of the driver.

rows.he: יְתוּר הָרִים מִרְעֵהוּ וְאַחַר כָּל־יָרוֹק יִדְרוֹשׁ׃
rows.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searcheth after every green thing.

rows.he: הֲיֹאבֶה רֵּים עָבְדֶךָ אִם־יָלִין עַל־אֲבוּסֶךָ׃
rows.en: Will the wild-ox be willing to serve thee? Or will he abide by thy crib?

rows.he: הֲ‍תִקְשָׁר־רֵים בְּתֶלֶם עֲבֹתוֹ אִם־יְשַׂדֵּד עֲמָקִים אַחֲרֶיךָ׃
rows.en: Canst thou bind the wild-ox with his band in the furrow? Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

rows.he: הֲתִבְטַח־בּוֹ כִּי־רַב כֹּחוֹ וְתַעֲזֹב אֵלָיו יְגִיעֶךָ׃
rows.en: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? Or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

rows.he: הֲתַאֲמִין בּוֹ כִּי־ישוב [יָשִׁיב] זַרְעֶךָ וְגָרְנְךָ יֶאֱסֹף׃
rows.en: Wilt thou rely on him, that he will bring home thy seed, And gather the corn of thy threshing-floor?

rows.he: כְּנַף־רְנָנִים נֶעֱלָסָה אִם־אֶבְרָה חֲסִידָה וְנֹצָה׃
rows.en: The wing of the ostrich beateth joyously; But are her pinions and feathers the kindly stork’s?

rows.he: כִּי־תַעֲזֹב לָאָרֶץ בֵּצֶיהָ וְעַל־עָפָר תְּחַמֵּם׃
rows.en: For she leaveth her eggs on the earth, And warmeth them in dust,

rows.he: וַתִּשְׁכַּח כִּי־רֶגֶל תְּזוּרֶהָ וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה תְּדוּשֶׁהָ׃
rows.en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, Or that the wild beast may trample them.

rows.he: הִקְשִׁיחַ בָּנֶיהָ לְּלֹא־לָהּ לְרִיק יְגִיעָהּ בְּלִי־פָחַד׃
rows.en: She is hardened against her young ones, as if they were not hers; Though her labour be in vain, she is without fear; .

rows.he: כִּי־הִשָּׁהּ אֱלוֹהַּ חָכְמָה וְלֹא־חָלַק לָהּ בַּבִּינָה׃
rows.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, Neither hath He imparted to her understanding.

rows.he: כָּעֵת בַּמָּרוֹם תַּמְרִיא תִּשְׂחַק לַסּוּס וּלְרֹכְבוֹ׃
rows.en: When the time cometh, she raiseth her wings on high, And scorneth the horse and his rider.

rows.he: הֲתִתֵּן לַסּוּס גְּבוּרָה הֲתַלְבִּישׁ צַוָּארוֹ רַעְמָה׃
rows.en: Hast thou given the horse his strength? Hast thou clothed his neck with fierceness?

rows.he: הְתַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּה הוֹד נַחְרוֹ אֵימָה׃
rows.en: Hast thou made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is terrible.

rows.he: יַחְפְּרוּ בָעֵמֶק וְיָשִׂישׂ בְּכֹחַ יֵצֵא לִקְרַאת־נָשֶׁק׃
rows.en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength; He goeth out to meet the clash of arms.

rows.he: יִשְׂחַק לְפַחַד וְלֹא יֵחָת וְלֹא־יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי־חָרֶב׃
rows.en: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; Neither turneth he back from the sword.

rows.he: עָלָיו תִּרְנֶה אַשְׁפָּה לַהַב חֲנִית וְכִידוֹן׃
rows.en: The quiver rattleth upon him, The glittering spear and the javelin.

rows.he: בְּרַעַשׁ וְרֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא־אָרֶץ וְלֹא־יַאֲמִין כִּי־קוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃
rows.en: He swalloweth the ground with storm and rage; Neither believeth he that it is the voice of the horn.

rows.he: בְּדֵי שֹׁפָר יֹאמַר הֶאָח וּמֵרָחוֹק יָרִיחַ מִלְחָמָה רַעַם שָׂרִים וּתְרוּעָה׃
rows.en: As oft as he heareth the horn he saith: ‘Ha, ha! ’ And he smelleth the battle afar off, The thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

rows.he: הֲ‍מִבִּינָתְךָ יַאֲבֶר־נֵץ יִפְרֹשׂ כנפו [כְּנָפָיו] לְתֵימָן׃
rows.en: Doth the hawk soar by thy wisdom, And stretch her wings toward the south?

rows.he: אִם־עַל־פִּיךָ יַגְבִּיהַּ נָשֶׁר וְכִי יָרִים קִנּוֹ׃
rows.en: Doth the vulture mount up at thy command, And make her nest on high?

rows.he: סֶלַע יִשְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָן עַל־שֶׁן־סֶלַע וּמְצוּדָה׃
rows.en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, Upon the crag of the rock, and the stronghold.

rows.he: מִשָּׁם חָפַר־אֹכֶל לְמֵרָחוֹק עֵינָיו יַבִּיטוּ׃
rows.en: From thence she spieth out the prey; Her eyes behold it afar off.

rows.he: ואפרחו [וְאֶפְרֹחָיו] יְעַלְעוּ־דָם וּבַאֲשֶׁר חֲלָלִים שָׁם הוּא׃
rows.en: Her young ones also suck up blood; And where the slain are, there is she.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said:

rows.he: הֲרֹב עִם־שַׁדַּי יִסּוֹר מוֹכִיחַ אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲנֶנָּה׃
rows.en: Shall he that reproveth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with God, let him answer it.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said:

rows.he: הֵן קַלֹּתִי מָה אֲשִׁיבֶךָּ יָדִי שַׂמְתִּי לְמוֹ־פִי׃
rows.en: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer Thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.

rows.he: אַחַת דִּבַּרְתִּי וְלֹא אֶעֱנֶה וּשְׁתַּיִם וְלֹא אוֹסִיף׃
rows.en: Once have I spoken, but I will not answer again; Yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן־יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב מנ סערה [מִן ] [סְעָרָה] וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:

rows.he: אֱזָר־נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
rows.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man; I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto Me. .

rows.he: הַאַף תָּפֵר מִשְׁפָּטִי תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדָּק׃
rows.en: Wilt thou even make void My judgment? Wilt thou condemn Me, that thou mayest be justified?

rows.he: וְאִם־זְרוֹעַ כָּאֵל לָךְ וּבְקוֹל כָּמֹהוּ תַרְעֵם׃
rows.en: Or hast thou an arm like God? And canst thou thunder with a voice like Him?

rows.he: עֲדֵה נָא גָאוֹן וָגֹבַהּ וְהוֹד וְהָדָר תִּלְבָּשׁ׃
rows.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency, And array thyself with glory and beauty.

rows.he: הָפֵץ עֶבְרוֹת אַפֶּךָ וּרְאֵה כָל־גֵּאֶה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵהוּ׃
rows.en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath; And look upon every one that is proud, and abase him.

rows.he: רְאֵה כָל־גֵּאֶה הַכְנִיעֵהוּ וַהֲדֹךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּחְתָּם׃
rows.en: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; And tread down the wicked in their place.

rows.he: טָמְנֵם בֶּעָפָר יָחַד פְּנֵיהֶם חֲבֹשׁ בַּטָּמוּן׃
rows.en: Hide them in the dust together; Bind their faces in the hidden place.

rows.he: וְגַם־אֲנִי אוֹדֶךָּ כִּי־תוֹשִׁעַ לְךָ יְמִינֶךָ׃
rows.en: Then will I also confess unto thee That thine own right hand can save thee.

rows.he: הִנֵּה־נָא בְהֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי עִמָּךְ חָצִיר כַּבָּקָר יֹאכֵל׃
rows.en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; He eateth grass as an ox.

rows.he: הִנֵּה־נָא כֹחוֹ בְמָתְנָיו וְאֹנוֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵי בִטְנוֹ׃
rows.en: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the stays of his body.

rows.he: יַחְפֹּץ זְנָבוֹ כְמוֹ־אָרֶז גִּידֵי פחדו [פַחֲדָיו] יְשֹׂרָגוּ׃
rows.en: He straineth his tail like a cedar; The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

rows.he: עֲצָמָיו אֲפִיקֵי נְחוּשָׁה גְּרָמָיו כִּמְטִיל בַּרְזֶל׃
rows.en: His bones are as pipes of brass; His gristles are like bars of iron.

rows.he: הוּא רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכֵי־אֵל הָעֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּשׁ חַרְבּוֹ׃
rows.en: He is the beginning of the ways of God; He only that made him can make His sword to approach unto him.

rows.he: כִּי־בוּל הָרִים יִשְׂאוּ־לוֹ וְכָל־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה יְשַׂחֲקוּ־שָׁם׃
rows.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, And all the beasts of the field play there.

rows.he: תַּחַת־צֶאֱלִים יִשְׁכָּב בְּסֵתֶר קָנֶה וּבִצָּה׃
rows.en: He lieth under the lotus-trees, In the covert of the reed, and fens.

rows.he: יְסֻכֻּהוּ צֶאֱלִים צִלֲלוֹ יְסֻבּוּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָחַל׃
rows.en: The lotus-trees cover him with their shadow; The willows of the brook compass him about.

rows.he: הֵן יַעֲשֹׁק נָהָר לֹא יַחְפּוֹז יִבְטַח כִּי־יָגִיחַ יַרְדֵּן אֶל־פִּיהוּ׃
rows.en: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; He is confident, though the Jordan rush forth to his mouth.

rows.he: בְּעֵינָיו יִקָּחֶנּוּ בְּמוֹקְשִׁים יִנְקָב־אָף׃
rows.en: Shall any take him by his eyes, Or pierce through his nose with a snare?

rows.he: תִּמְשֹׁךְ לִוְיָתָן בְּחַכָּה וּבְחֶבֶל תַּשְׁקִיעַ לְשֹׁנוֹ׃
rows.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a fish-hook? Or press down his tongue with a cord?

rows.he: הֲתָשִׂים אַגְמוֹן בְּאַפּוֹ וּבְחוֹחַ תִּקּוֹב לֶחֱיוֹ׃
rows.en: Canst thou put a ring into his nose? Or bore his jaw through with a hook?

rows.he: הֲיַרְבֶּה אֵלֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִים אִם־יְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ רַכּוֹת׃
rows.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Or will he speak soft words unto thee?

rows.he: הֲיִכְרֹת בְּרִית עִמָּךְ תִּקָּחֶנּוּ לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם׃
rows.en: Will he make a covenant with thee, That thou shouldest take him for a servant for ever?

rows.he: הַתְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ כַּצִּפּוֹר וְתִקְשְׁרֶנּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶיךָ׃
rows.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens? .

rows.he: יִכְרוּ עָלָיו חַבָּרִים יֶחֱצוּהוּ בֵּין כְּנַעֲנִים׃
rows.en: Will the bands of fishermen make a banquet of him? Will they part him among the merchants?

rows.he: הַתְמַלֵּא בְשֻׂכּוֹת עוֹרוֹ וּבְצִלְצַל דָּגִים רֹאשׁוֹ׃
rows.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? Or his head with fish-spears?

rows.he: שִׂים־עָלָיו כַּפֶּךָ זְכֹר מִלְחָמָה אַל־תּוֹסַף׃
rows.en: Lay thy hand upon him; Think upon the battle, thou wilt do so no more.

rows.he: הֵן־תֹּחַלְתּוֹ נִכְזָבָה הֲגַם אֶל־מַרְאָיו יֻטָל׃
rows.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain; Shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

rows.he: לֹא־אַכְזָר כִּי יְעוּרֶנּוּ וּמִי הוּא לְפָנַי יִתְיַצָּב׃
rows.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up; Who then is able to stand before Me?

rows.he: מִי הִקְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם לִי־הוּא׃
rows.en: Who hath given Me anything beforehand, that I should repay him? Whatsoever is under the whole heaven is Mine.

rows.he: לא־[לוֹ־] אַחֲרִישׁ בַּדָּיו וּדְבַר־גְּבוּרוֹת וְחִין עֶרְכּוֹ׃
rows.en: Would I keep silence concerning his boastings, or his proud talk, or his fair array of words?

rows.he: מִי־גִלָּה פְּנֵי לְבוּשׁוֹ בְּכֶפֶל רִסְנוֹ מִי יָבוֹא׃
rows.en: Who can uncover the face of his garment? Who shall come within his double bridle?

rows.he: דַּלְתֵי פָנָיו מִי פִתֵּחַ סְבִיבוֹת שִׁנָּיו אֵימָה׃
rows.en: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.

rows.he: גַּאֲוָה אֲפִיקֵי מָגִנִּים סָגוּר חוֹתָם צָר׃
rows.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

rows.he: אֶחָד בְּאֶחָד יִגַּשׁוּ וְרוּחַ לֹא־יָבוֹא בֵינֵיהֶם׃
rows.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

rows.he: אִישׁ־בְּאָחִיהוּ יְדֻבָּקוּ יִתְלַכְּדוּ וְלֹא יִתְפָּרָדוּ׃
rows.en: They are joined one to another; They stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

rows.he: עֲ‍טִישֹׁתָיו תָּהֶל אוֹר וְעֵינָיו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָׁחַר׃
rows.en: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

rows.he: מִפִּיו לַפִּידִים יַהֲלֹכוּ כִּידוֹדֵי אֵשׁ יִתְמַלָּטוּ׃
rows.en: Out of his mouth go burning torches, and sparks of fire leap forth.

rows.he: מִנְּחִירָיו יֵצֵא עָשָׁן כְּדוּד נָפוּחַ וְאַגְמֹן׃
rows.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot and burning rushes.

rows.he: נַפְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִים תְּלַהֵט וְלַהַב מִפִּיו יֵצֵא׃
rows.en: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

rows.he: בְּצַוָּארוֹ יָלִין עֹז וּלְפָנָיו תָּדוּץ דְּאָבָה׃
rows.en: In his neck abideth strength, and dismay danceth before him.

rows.he: מַפְּלֵי בְשָׂרוֹ דָבֵקוּ יָצוּק עָלָיו בַּל־יִמּוֹט׃
rows.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together; they are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.

rows.he: לִבּוֹ יָצוּק כְּמוֹ־אָבֶן וְיָצוּק כְּפֶלַח תַּחְתִּית׃
rows.en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, firm as the nether millstone.

rows.he: מִשֵּׂתוֹ יָגוּרוּ אֵלִים מִשְּׁבָרִים יִתְחַטָּאוּ׃
rows.en: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid; by reason of despair they are beside themselves.

rows.he: מַשִּׂיגֵהוּ חֶרֶב בְּלִי תָקוּם חֲנִית מַסָּע וְשִׁרְיָה׃
rows.en: If one lay at him with the sword, it will not hold; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

rows.he: יַחְשֹׁב לְתֶבֶן בַּרְזֶל לְעֵץ רִקָּבוֹן נְחוּשָׁה׃
rows.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

rows.he: לֹא־יַבְרִיחֶנּוּ בֶן־קָשֶׁת לְקַשׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ־לוֹ אַבְנֵי־קָלַע׃
rows.en: The arrow cannot make him flee; slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

rows.he: כְּקַשׁ נֶחְשְׁבוּ תוֹתָח וְיִשְׂחַק לְרַעַשׁ כִּידוֹן׃
rows.en: Clubs are accounted as stubble; He laugheth at the rattling of the javelin.

rows.he: תַּחְתָּיו חַדּוּדֵי חָרֶשׂ יִרְפַּד חָרוּץ עֲלֵי־טִיט׃
rows.en: Sharpest potsherds are under him; He spreadeth a threshing-sledge upon the mire.

rows.he: יַרְתִּיחַ כַּסִּיר מְצוּלָה יָם יָשִׂים כַּמֶּרְקָחָה׃
rows.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot; He maketh the sea like a seething mixture.

rows.he: אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר נָתִיב יַחְשֹׁב תְּהוֹם לְשֵׂיבָה׃
rows.en: He maketh a path to shine after him; One would think the deep to be hoary.

rows.he: אֵין־עַל־עָפָר מָשְׁלוֹ הֶעָשׂוּ לִבְלִי־חָת׃
rows.en: Upon earth there is not his like who is made to be fearless.

rows.he: אֵת־כָּל־גָּבֹהַּ יִרְאֶה הוּא מֶלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־בְּנֵי־שָׁחַץ׃
rows.en: He looketh at all high things; He is king over all the proud beasts.

rows.he: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר׃
rows.en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said:

rows.he: ידעת [יָדַעְתִּי] כִּי־כֹל תּוּכָל וְלֹא־יִבָּצֵר מִמְּךָ מְזִמָּה׃
rows.en: I know that Thou canst do every thing, And that no purpose can be withholden from Thee.

rows.he: מִי זֶה מַעְלִים עֵצָה בְּלִי דָעַת לָכֵן הִגַּדְתִּי וְלֹא אָבִין נִפְלָאוֹת מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא אֵדָע׃
rows.en: Who is this that hideth counsel without knowledge? Therefore have I uttered that which I understood not, Things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

rows.he: שְׁמַע־נָא וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
rows.en: Hear, I beseech Thee, and I will speak; I will demand of Thee, and declare Thou unto me.

rows.he: לְשֵׁמַע־אֹזֶן שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ וְעַתָּה עֵינִי רָאָתְךָ׃
rows.en: I had heard of Thee by the hearing of the ear; But now mine eye seeth Thee;

rows.he: עַל־כֵּן אֶמְאַס וְנִחַמְתִּי עַל־עָפָר וָאֵפֶר׃
rows.en: Wherefore I abhor my words, and repent, Seeing I am dust and ashes.

rows.he: וַיְהִי אַחַר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי חָרָה אַפִּי בְךָ וּבִשְׁנֵי רֵעֶיךָ כִּי לֹא דִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלַי נְכוֹנָה כְּעַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב׃
rows.en: And it was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite: ‘My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends; for ye have not spoken of Me the thing that is right, as My servant Job hath.

rows.he: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־לָכֶם שִׁבְעָה־פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים וּלְכוּ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב וְהַעֲלִיתֶם עוֹלָה בַּעַדְכֶם וְאִיּוֹב עַבְדִּי יִתְפַּלֵּל עֲלֵיכֶם כִּי אִם־פָּנָיו אֶשָּׂא לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת עִמָּכֶם נְבָלָה כִּי לֹא דִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלַי נְכוֹנָה כְּעַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב׃
rows.en: Now therefore, take unto you seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to My servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt-offering; and My servant Job shall pray for you; for him will I accept, that I do not unto you aught unseemly; for ye have not spoken of Me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.’

rows.he: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וּבִלְדַּד הַשּׁוּחִי צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוָה וַיִּשָּׂא יְהוָה אֶת־פְּנֵי אִיּוֹב׃
rows.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them; and the LORD accepted Job.

rows.he: וַיהוָה שָׁב אֶת־שבית [שְׁבוּת] אִיּוֹב בְּהִתְפַּלְלוֹ בְּעַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיֹּסֶף יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לְאִיּוֹב לְמִשְׁנֶה׃
rows.en: And the LORD changed the fortune of Job, when he prayed for his friends; and the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

rows.he: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלָיו כָּל־אֶחָיו וְכָל־אחיתיו [אַחְיוֹתָיו] וְכָל־יֹדְעָיו לְפָנִים וַיֹּאכְלוּ עִמּוֹ לֶחֶם בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיָּנֻדוּ לוֹ וַיְנַחֲמוּ אֹתוֹ עַל כָּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא יְהוָה עָלָיו וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ אִישׁ קְשִׂיטָה אֶחָת וְאִישׁ נֶזֶם זָהָב אֶחָד׃
rows.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house; and they bemoaned him, and comforted him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him; every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one a ring of gold.

rows.he: וַיהוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת־אַחֲרִית אִיּוֹב מֵרֵאשִׁתוֹ וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף צֹאן וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים גְּמַלִּים וְאֶלֶף־צֶמֶד בָּקָר וְאֶלֶף אֲתוֹנוֹת׃
rows.en: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning; and he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she-asses. .

rows.he: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שִׁבְעָנָה בָנִים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ בָּנוֹת׃
rows.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

rows.he: וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם־הָאַחַת יְמִימָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית קְצִיעָה וְשֵׁם הַשְּׁלִישִׁית קֶרֶן הַפּוּךְ׃
rows.en: And he called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

rows.he: וְלֹא נִמְצָא נָשִׁים יָפוֹת כִּבְנוֹת אִיּוֹב בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶם׃
rows.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job; and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

rows.he: וַיְחִי אִיּוֹב אַחֲרֵי־זֹאת מֵאָה וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וירא [וַיִּרְאֶה] אֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בְּנֵי בָנָיו אַרְבָּעָה דֹּרוֹת׃
rows.en: And after this Job lived a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’sons, even four generations.

rows.he: וַיָּמָת אִיּוֹב זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים׃
rows.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
